jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Role summary

Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day.

We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted.

Responsibilities

  • Product vision, grounded in real user needs

You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind.

  • Market scoping and opportunity-spotting

Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog.

  • Logistics know-how turned into product decisions 

Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you.

  • The full lifecycle

From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear.

  • The connective tissue across the company 

When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together.

The team you’ll join

You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today.

Life at Bluerock

We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock.


  • 5+ years in product or project management within logistics, supply chain, or TMS — hands-on TMS experience is required.

  • Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field  required.

  • A track record of delivering complex, high-stakes software implementations, on time and within budget.

  • Genuine ease operating cross-functionally. You connect engineering, sales, implementation, and customers without waiting for permission.

  • An appetite for ambiguity and change: a messy, fragmented workflow reads to you as an interesting problem.

  • Nice to have: API integration experience (WMS, ERP, visibility providers, customs), fluency with Agile tooling (Jira, Asana, Rocketlane), and PMP/PRINCE2 certification.

  • Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage customer relationships and stakeholder expectations effectively.

  • Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on delivering results in a fast-paced environment

Our hiring process

  • Hit the Apply button.

  • Join a 30 minute video call in the Introduction Interview

  • A couple of deeper interviews built to be a win-win, not an interrogation.

  • An offer, and the start of your journey with Bluerock TMS.


Bluerock TMS is an equal opportunities employer. We take pride in our diverse workforce and inclusive workplace. Within a small team of open-minded talents, we ensure an attractive learning environment that you are looking for!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager Software
jobs.description:
About Optics11

Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

The Role

As Senior Product Manager Software you will build a deep understanding of the software we supply to our defense partners and clients.

You will have full product ownership including strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle and contribute to adjacent hardware product strategy and propositions to, jointly with our hardware product managers, build end-to-end solutions for our defense partners and clients. You build and structure our product discovery and delivery ways of working for the software domain.

You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with our hardware Product Managers, Data science, Software, R&D, Engineering Sales, Projects and Application Engineering teams.

No two weeks will look the same. You might speak with a defense partner about an operational challenge, turn feedback from a deployed product into a roadmap decision, test the feasibility of a new capability with System Engineering, or work with the Product Owner to translate priorities into executable increments. You will also collaborate with hardware Product Managers, Engineering, Sales and Customer Projects to ensure our software and hardware come together as one coherent solution.

You will own the software product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle, from discovery and business case through prioritization, delivery and performance.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have established a clear, evidence-based software strategy, strengthened our discovery and delivery practices, and aligned teams around the capabilities that matter most. Your work will reduce uncertainty, improve investment decisions and help Optics11 deliver scalable, commercially strong software products that solve real problems for customers operating in demanding, high-stakes environments.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the software product strategy by defining and articulating the direction for assigned software products or value streams, identifying customer problems and market opportunities, and balance near-term opportunities with long-term company goals.

• Provide product design authority by ensuring software concepts, capabilities and development choices remain aligned with the Underwater Security product vision and strategy throughout the product lifecycle.

• Lead customer and market discovery by developing a deep understanding of customer needs, operational use cases and buying contexts, validating direction with customers and partners, and synthesizing feedback from deployed products.

• Own software roadmap development and prioritization by defining the capabilities required to address validated needs, balancing improvements, new functionality and technology evolution, and communicating priorities across relevant teams.

• Develop business cases and commercial input by defining success measures and commercial objectives, providing evidence for portfolio investment decisions, and supporting Product Marketing with product knowledge for pricing and launch readiness.

• Coordinate the product core team by working with System Engineering on requirements and feasibility, Product Ownership on executable increments, and Project Management on customer delivery, while aligning Sales, Business Development, Customer Projects and Engineering around progress, quality and outcomes.


• Master’s degree in engineering or design, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of experience in Software Product Management, with a proven track record of developing, deploying and maintaining software (platform) driven solutions in defense industry or another industrial high-tech / high compliance environment

• Strong understanding of software products, particularly in complex and regulated environments, e.g., industrial environments.

• In-depth knowledge of software product management and – strategy methodologies.

• Demonstratable experience in defining software product strategy and creating complete business cases.

• Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills at operational and management level

• Demonstrated critical thinking, adaptability to challenges, and a problem-solving mindset to creatively address user pain points.

• Proficiency in software industry standard tooling for software development and road mapping such as Jira / Jira Product Discovery / Jira Service Management, Confluence, BigPicture

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of conveying product level knowledge, decisions and roadmaps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Willingness to travel

• Drivers’ license B (or international equivalent)

Nice to Have

• Experience in defense industry or another industrial high-tech / high compliance environment

• Proficiency in JAMA Connect, Siemens Polarion, SAFe, Miro, Figma, Dovetail, Amplitude, PowerBI

• Proficiency in Dutch language is a plus

Security screening

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please check:

https://english.aivd.nl/topics/s/security-screening

jobs.title: Client Delivery Lead - Payments
jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Customer

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimising resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

We have been licensing Kraken since 2019. Throughout this time, the Delivery team has been at the forefront of industry-leading migrations, setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. These transformations go far beyond technology: we work with clients to rethink their operating models and ways of working, while continuously making the most of Kraken's evolving capabilities.

 

Client Delivery sits at the heart of Kraken’s transformation journeys, at the intersection of our clients and the product and engineering teams building Kraken 🚀 We lead conversations around our clients’ most important needs, help them unlock the value of Kraken and turn complex challenges into opportunities to evolve the platform, keeping Kraken innovative, relevant and ahead of where the energy market is going.

 

It’s a high-impact, hands-on team where you’ll influence both how our clients transform and what Kraken becomes next 💡 You’ll work alongside other Client Delivery Leads (across the same client and areas of expertise) as well as Transformation Directors and Technical Programme Leads, bringing together the right perspectives to challenge thinking, drive change and deliver the best possible outcomes for our clients.

 

🚀 What you'll own:

  • As a Client Delivery Lead you will be at the forefront of the transformation journey with our clients.

  • You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners).

  • You will have full ownership of a domain or product area for your client and act as a key point of contact for technology development and issue resolution within your domain or product area.

  • You will build a deep understanding of Kraken, as well as client needs and priorities, to provide expert advice and identify the best solutions, balancing the use of existing Kraken capabilities with the need for custom-built solutions.

  • You will triage and prioritise incoming requests, clearly articulating client needs, priorities and timelines to the right Kraken teams to support effective delivery and the ongoing development of the platform.

  • You will work closely with product managers and developers to translate client needs into clear priorities and support the delivery of product features.

  • You will challenge clients to think differently about technology development, championing Kraken's iterative approach and shared platform over bespoke solutions.

  • You will be committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change.

 

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • Strong client delivery, product ownership/management experience, including client-facing (often senior) stakeholder management.

  • Experience managing technology products, migration/implementation projects or complex delivery in an agile environment.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate complex client needs into clear action-plans and impactful solutions.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration and influencing skills, with the confidence to challenge traditional ways of thinking and drive change

  • Experience navigating complex delivery pipelines, competing priorities and changing environments.

  • A proactive, adaptable and hands-on mindset, willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, frequently flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organization.

  • Resilience and empathy, staying positive and persistent through challenges while understanding the human impact of transformation and supporting clients through change with patience and sensitivity.

  • We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open-minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever-changing environment.

⭐ Bonus points:

  • Consulting experience.

  • Experience with large-scale technology transformations, migrations or enterprise platforms.

  • Experience in energy, utilities or another regulated or complex industry.

 

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients: Growth & Expansion
jobs.description:
Your Role

As Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients (f/m/d) you own the complete growth loop for LIQID's digitally-led clients: from a newly created lead to the first investment, and from there to the next top-up, the second portfolio and the next product. Acquisition and expansion sit in one team with one mandate, so you build a single growth system instead of handing clients over at the funnel's end. LIQID is hybrid by design: for this segment the experience is digital-first, and you decide precisely where a human touch from our advisors accelerates conversion or growth – and where it doesn't.

What you'll do

  • End-to-End Segment Ownership: Own the digital client lifecycle from Lead → Signup → Checkout → First Investment → Activation → Expansion. You define the segment's North Star and KPI tree across conversion and expansion – lead-to-funded conversion, time to fund, time to first top-up, multi-product rate, share of wallet – and you are accountable for net new money from the segment, not for a single funnel stage.

  • Lead Conversion & Onboarding Experience: Design and optimize the journeys that turn leads into funded clients – lead nurturing, signup, onboarding and checkout – together with Product Design, Marketing and Sales. You shape the first-product strategy – which entry offer converts which persona – and make sure the brand promise and premium positioning carry through every step that builds trust and drives conversion.

  • Digital Up- & Cross-Sell: Turn first-time investors into multi-product clients: top-ups and savings plans, second portfolios, additional account types and access to new asset classes such as private markets. You find natural product sequences through path and cohort analysis, build the in-product moments and lifecycle campaigns that convert them, and prove impact with causal measurement rather than correlation stories.

  • Hybrid Where It Pays Off: Define when a human touch turns a hesitant prospect into a client or a single-product client into a long-term relationship – callback offers at checkout drop-off, advisor triggers at wealth thresholds, and a clean handover to our Private Wealth team as clients grow. Every human touchpoint is designed, triggered and measured, not left to chance.

  • Thought Leadership with Hands-on Mentality: Act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional team of Engineering, Design and Product Ops, working closely with Marketing and Sales. Y ou build on shared onboarding and banking infrastructure owned by our platform teams, prioritize transparently by impact and effort – which also means saying no – and grow into the thought leader for digital wealth growth at LIQID.

What you bring

  • Background: 7+ years in Product Management or Growth for digital consumer products, with ownership of both conversion and monetization or expansion outcomes. FinTech, WealthTech, banking or subscription businesses are a strong plus.

  • Growth & Analytical Depth: Hands-on with funnel, cohort and LTV analysis. You define metrics before you build, establish baselines, can query data yourself, and know the difference between a significant result and a lucky one.

  • Technical & AI Fluency: Experience working with product analytics and CRM data. You are comfortable discussing architecture and API trade-offs with engineers and use AI tooling to prototype, analyze and ship faster.

  • Domain Curiosity & Client Empathy: Genuine interest in investing and capital markets, and an understanding that converting someone to invest a significant share of their wealth is a trust decision, not an impulse purchase.

  • Communication & Language: Fluent in German and English, able to align Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing and Sales around one growth agenda and to represent your roadmap credibly toward leadership. Drive & Motivation: Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership scale-up environments. Y ou want to own outcomes, not backlogs, and you are excited to build the growth engine of a digital-first wealth manager in an AI-native product organization.

What we offer

  • Diversity: Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one.

  • Flexibility: We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind.

  • Appreciation: You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas.

jobs.description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You’ll own Measurement & Reporting: the product surface where Vibe turns campaign delivery into proof. Performance is why clients pick Vibe. Trusted, actionable measurement is why they stay and scale with us.

Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll own the strategy and roadmap for how Vibe explains and proves the impact of CTV advertising across every vertical. Your main focus will be ecom and CPG, with growing coverage of apps, local, and travel. The goal is to make CTV outcomes as trustworthy and actionable as search and social, so clients confidently move more budget to Vibe.

You’ll work daily with Data Science, Data Platform, Engineering, and our client-facing teams (CS, Sales, TAM). With Walmart’s purchase data now part of the platform, measurement is becoming one of Vibe’s biggest differentiators.

What You’ll Do

Reporting & Insight

  • Own advertiser-facing reporting, including dashboards, outcome metrics, and exports that make CTV performance clear to both technical and non-technical buyers.

  • Turn raw performance data into benchmarks and insights clients can grasp at a glance.

Attribution & Incrementality

  • Productize attribution and incrementality to a client-grade standard, not just an internal signal.

  • Own integrations with the measurement tools clients already trust, such as MMPs, web/CAPI pixels, MMM, and third-party partners (e.g. Northbeam, Haus), so Vibe’s numbers hold up next to Meta and Google.

  • Guarantee data accuracy, transparent methodology, and defensible results.

Activation

  • Translate measurement into clear recommendations and next actions that drive spend decisions.

  • Close the loop between proven outcomes and campaign optimization, powering the “more performance → more spend” flywheel.

  • Partner with CS, Sales, and TAM to make measurement the core of how we retain and grow clients.

  • Use SQL and log-level data to validate methodologies, size opportunities, and prioritize by impact.

What You Need

  • 5+ years in Product Management on performance AdTech, measurement/attribution, or analytics products.

  • Strong grasp of digital measurement (attribution models, incrementality and causal testing, MMM) and of why click-based models break for CTV.

  • Solid statistical literacy, including experimental design, holdouts, significance, and confidence intervals.

  • A track record of shipping client-facing reporting or insight products, and of making complex data simple and trustworthy for marketers.

  • Fluency with outcome KPIs across verticals and with the ecom/CPG performance stack.

  • Hands-on SQL and data exploration, and you’re comfortable in technical, data-intensive environments.

  • The ability to bridge technical measurement and business/GTM stakeholders.

Why This Role

  • You’ll own the product domain that decides whether clients trust their Vibe spend, and whether they scale it.

  • You’ll have a direct line to revenue, because measurement is Vibe’s main lever for retaining and growing clients.

  • You’ll shape how an entire category proves CTV as a performance channel.

  • You’ll have high autonomy and influence across functions, from data science to clients’ C-suite.

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

The base pay range for this role in Paris is €99,000 – €133,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

The base pay range for this role in New York is $108,000 – $216,000. We will support relocation to New York for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here’s how we back that up:

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We’re in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here’s exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting.

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes. We’ll share more context on the role and team, and learn more about your background and what you’re looking for.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes. Meet with the person you’d work with directly and dive deeper into your experience, product background, and approach to the role.

  3. Technical Discussion — 90 minutes. A deeper conversation covering product thinking, measurement methodology, data reasoning, and a use case relevant to the role.

  4. Bar Raiser Interview — 30 minutes. Meet with a senior leader at Vibe for a final conversation and an opportunity to ask any remaining questions.

  5. Offer — We move quickly once we’ve made a decision. We don’t let good decisions sit.

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Die Rolle

Wir haben in den letzten Jahren gezeigt, dass wir echte Kundenprobleme lösen können. Jetzt geht es darum, aus bewährten Lösungen wiederholbare Produkte zu machen, die sich skalierbar verkaufen und liefern lassen. Genau dafür suchen wir Dich!

Du machst aus validierten Kundenlösungen skalierbare Produkte. Unser Product-Modell folgt drei Phasen: 0→1 (Kundenproblem verstehen, Lösung im Kundenfall beweisen), 1→n (daraus ein wiederholbares Produkt machen) und n (skalierbar verkaufen, liefern, weiterentwickeln).

Dein Fokus liegt auf 1→ n1→n: Du klärst, was das Produkt ist, für wen, welchen messbaren Mehrwert es liefert und wie es als Standardangebot verkauft und geliefert wird. Du verantwortest Produkt und Produktisierung – Engineering, Delivery, Sales und Product Marketing bleiben für Umsetzung, Kundenprojekt, Opportunity und Vermarktung zuständig. Darüber hinaus verantwortest Du den Lifecycle bestehender Produkte: Du sicherst ihre Stärken und Standards und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Validierte Lösungen konsequent in wiederholbare, standardisierte Angebote überführen

  • Zielkunden, Pain, Business Value und Value Proposition schärfen

  • Klaren Standardumfang und klare Produktgrenzen definieren – inklusive dessen, was bewusst nicht dazugehört

  • Gemeinsam mit Engineering die notwendige Produktreife herstellen

  • Kundenfeedback pragmatisch in Produktentscheidungen übersetzen

  • Product Marketing die fachliche Grundlage für Positionierung, Messaging und Content geben

  • Sales und Presales befähigen, das Produkt ohne permanente Product-Unterstützung zu erklären und zu verkaufen

  • Delivery befähigen, Einführung und Betrieb mit kalkulierbarem Aufwand umzusetzen

  • Lifecycle, Weiterentwicklung und Priorisierung verantworten, für neu produktisierte ebenso wie für bestehende Produkte, deren Stärken und Standards es zu sichern gilt

Was Du mitbringst

  • 5+ Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Product Management im komplexen B2B- bzw. Enterprise-Software-Umfeld

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, aus individuellen Kundenanforderungen, Piloten oder Prototypen ein standardisiertes, wiederholbares Produkt zu machen

  • Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis für komplexe Software-, Daten- und AI-Produkte: Du arbeitest mit Engineering auf Augenhöhe und verbindest Business, Kunde, Produkt und Technologie – ohne selbst Engineer sein zu müssen

  • Pragmatische Arbeitsweise mit starkem 80/20-Schnitt und schneller Entscheidungsfähigkeit auch bei unvollständigen Informationen, getragen von fundierter methodischer Product-Erfahrung

  • Hohe Ownership: Risiken früh erkennen und mit einer klaren Empfehlung kommen statt mit der Bitte um mehr Zeit oder Ressourcen

  • Klarer Fokus auf Business Value und Ergebnisse statt auf Prozesse, mit dem Talent, Komplexität zu reduzieren

  • Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine vor Ort

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift

Was die Rolle nicht ist

Damit Du einschätzen kannst, ob die Rolle zu Dir passt: Wir suchen bewusst nicht

  • einen klassischen Product Owner mit Schwerpunkt Backlog und Tickets,

  • einen reinen Projektmanager,

  • einen weiteren 0→1-Innovator,

  • einen Presales-Spezialisten,

  • einen reinen Strategen,

  • einen technischen Product Manager, der primär in Features und Architektur denkt.

Benefits:

  • Echte Gestaltungsverantwortung: Du prägst eine neu definierte Rolle und unser Product-Betriebsmodell für 2027 und darüber hinaus

  • Kurze Wege: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Engineering, Sales und Delivery

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeiten, flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

Jouw rol
 

Als Product Owner binnen het CCC:

  • geef je richting aan de doorontwikkeling van het Univé‑cloudplatform op basis van de CCC‑visie en het Cloud Capability Model;

  • werk je nauw samen met architectuur, security en de MSP om standaarden, kaders en guardrails te definiëren en te bewaken;

  • maak je keuzes die bijdragen aan standaardisatie, toekomstbestendigheid en veilige autonomie van productteams;

  • prioriteer je de backlog in balans tussen innovatie, betrouwbaarheid, vervolgtechniek en compliance;

  • fungeer je als sparringpartner voor engineers, architecten en de MSP;

  • borg je dat nieuwe cloudcapaciteiten voldoen aan ontwerpprincipes, governance‑richtlijnen en security‑eisen;

  • stimuleer je kennisdeling en samenwerking binnen Univé. 

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden


Strategie & Roadmap

  • vertalen van de CCC‑visie naar een concrete productstrategie;

  • opstellen en bewaken van de roadmap voor platformdiensten, automatisering, landing zones en PaaS‑diensten;

Samenwerking & Regie

  • voeren van regie op de MSP en bewaken van kwaliteit, volwassenheid en doorontwikkeling;

  • afstemmen met architectuur, security, servicemanagement en productteams;

Techniek & Inhoud

  • begrijpen van centrale cloudcomponenten zoals landing zones, netwerken, security‑baselines, automatisering en containerplatformen;

  • doorvertalen van technische kaders naar backlogitems;

Governance & Kwaliteit

  • waarborgen van compliance, standaardisatie en veilige cloudadoptie binnen Univé;

  • monitoren van platformprestaties en servicekwaliteit. 

Wat bieden wij

  • een sleutelrol binnen het Cloud Competence Center;

  • ruimte om te pionieren en professionaliseren;

  • afwisseling tussen architectuur en hands‑on engineering;

  • collega’s die voor kwaliteit en eenvoud gaan;

Bij Univé IT bieden we je een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische organisatie. De salarisrange ligt tussen € 64.830,24 en € 93.155,08 bruto per jaar op basis van een 38-urige werk-week (inclusief vakantiegeld, een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning).

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dicht bij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie.

Drie focusgebieden

jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Program Management Teams

We’re seeking an exceptional Customer Program Manager to join our Germany-based team focused on localising and advancing Wayve’s autonomous driving technology for the German market. This is a unique opportunity to play a hands-on role in shaping our AV capabilities in Germany from the ground up.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Lead cross-functional teams in executing complex customer programs, ensuring the successful achievement of program objectives.

  • Establish and maintain a comprehensive project management framework, including project planning, risk management, change management, and task coordination.

  • Engage with customers to understand and address their technical requirements and needs.

  • Work closely with internal development teams to align customer requirements with internal milestone planning and execution.

  • Provide first-level support to customers, ensuring their needs are met promptly and effectively.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

In this role, you will be responsible for leading and overseeing programs with OEM customers, spanning from early-stage advanced development initiatives to full-scale production programs. You will collaborate closely with the customer to define and manage project plans, ensuring that requirements are seamlessly integrated into the internal development pipeline and delivered on schedule. A deep understanding of the automotive industry and the development of embodied AI systems is essential to effectively guide these programs, identify and report potential risks, and implement a robust change management. You will be at the forefront of delivering meaningful impact to real-world customers.

 

🙌 You should apply if

Essential

  • Extensive program management experience in complex automotive software development.

  • Proficient in utilising program management tools (e.g., Jira) to optimise workflow efficiency and ensure seamless project execution.

  • Robust technical expertise with comprehensive knowledge of the automotive industry and software development.

  • A proactive problem-solving mindset.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Willingness to travel as needed.

Desirable

  • Knowledge of current AI advancements, including Generative AI, AV 2.0, and Large Language Models (LLMs).

  • Hands-on experience in software development (Python, C++, Rust, …).

  • A Master’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews [Experience conversation with Hiring Manager, 60mins]

  • Deep-dive technical interviews [Automotive Product, 60mins, Program Management & Cross Functional Collaboration, 60mins]

  • Final interview: [Mission & Values alignment, 30mins].

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Als Jurist/in mit mind. 1. Staatsexamen oder Abschluss eines Studiums in Wirtschaftsjura oder vergleichbaren Studiengängen bringst Du Neugier und Offenheit für Technologien und die Digitalisierung mit. Neben Deinem juristischen Verständnis hast Du auch ein Verständnis für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und das Pareto Prinzip ist kein Fremdwort für Dich.

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by two leading VCs (TQ Ventures & Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

Every day, millions of travelers book buses, trains, ferries and transfers through platforms they know, and many of those bookings run on Distribusion. We connect hundreds of carriers with the world’s leading travel retailers, making ground transport as easy to book as a flight.


We’re looking for ambitious graduates who want real responsibility from day one. As part of our Graduate Program, you’ll join one of our core teams as an Analyst or Engineer, work on live products used across the globe, and learn alongside people who are building the infrastructure of ground travel.

Workplace: Berlin & Remote or willing to relocate to Berlin.

Where you could make your mark

Product: Analyst roles

  • Search Engine & Booking Platform: Build the core engine that returns fast, scalable search results and handles thousands of booking requests per second.

  • Supply & Integrations: Connect hundreds of external carrier APIs and help build robust, fault‑tolerant infrastructure that keeps bookings flowing.

  • E‑commerce: Shape the booking engines, payment flows and user journeys that let travelers search, book, pay for and manage trips. Your work directly moves conversion and retention for a global audience across many markets, currencies and languages.

  • Connectivity: Build enterprise‑grade integrations with external systems like Salesforce, SAP, CRMs and government authorities, with a strong focus on automation and innovation.

Tech: Engineer roles

  • Demand Engineering: Work on the heart of our platform: the search and booking engine that lets the world’s biggest travel retailers sell bus and rail tickets through a single API, and the schedule system behind hundreds of thousands of daily departures used by hundreds of operators. Build high‑throughput microservices, help modernize our core search engine, and shape the product, not just the code.

  • Content Engineering: Build the pipelines that keep global travel data accurate and up to date. Automate how we ingest stations, prices and schedule changes in real time, and apply AI to keep millions of data points reliable at scale.

Partnerships roles

  • Regional Partnerships: Work hands‑on with bus, rail, ferry and transfer operators and leading travel retailers in your region, guiding them from first integration to growing their bookings across our global network.

  • Corporate Partnerships: Bring ground transport into business travel by working with travel management companies, corporate travel agencies and booking tools, from technical onboarding to growing the partnership.

  • Performance & Growth: Dig into partner data, spot opportunities, and build the processes and automation that help us scale.

  • STEM or tech-related academic background - You’re a recent (or soon-to-be) graduate in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, Business/Information Systems, or a similar field.
    Analytical mindset & problem-solving     - You love digging into complex problems, understanding how things work, and turning ambiguity into clear, structured solutions.

  • Technical curiosity: You have a basic understanding of APIs, systems or digital products (through studies, internships or projects), and you’re excited to build with AI, whether that’s experimenting with new tools, prototyping ideas or putting AI to work on real problems in a high‑scale environment.

  • Strong communication - You can explain ideas clearly, whether talking to engineers, product managers, or business teams — and you enjoy bridging technical and non-technical worlds.

  • Collaborative & cross-functional - You like working with diverse teams and feel comfortable contributing to group projects, Agile teamwork, and shared problem-solving.

  • Fast learner & adaptable - You thrive in dynamic environments, pick up new tools and concepts quickly, and stay resilient when things change or are not fully defined.

  • Ownership & ambition - You’re eager to take responsibility early, bring ideas to the table, and help shape processes that improve how products get delivered.


What you can expect:

  • Global reach & real-world impact - You help build software that enables travel for millions of people globally; your work supports real journeys across countries and continents, and makes transportation more accessible.

  • Cutting-edge tech in a high‑scale environment - From microservices and real-time search to AI-based content automation and cloud infrastructure, you’ll gain hands-on experience with many modern technologies and complex systems.

  • Fast growth & startup energy - Distribusion is rapidly expanding globally (70+ countries, hundreds of carriers/retailers), backed by strong funding — you’ll have the opportunity to take real ownership early, learn fast, and grow with the company.

Who We Are

Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a Swiss data and AI consulting company helping organisations in traditional industries solve complex challenges in areas such as operations, finance, manufacturing and R&D. We work at the intersection of technology and business, delivering data and AI solutions that create practical value for our clients.

Our teams have delivered projects across industries including automotive, chemicals, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We are a Palantir partner and work with clients across the full data and AI journey, from understanding a business problem to building and deploying the solution.

Unit8 has delivered more than 300 projects and grown to a team of 190+ talented people across ten office locations. Following our growth across Europe and our expansion into North America, we are now building our presence in the United Arab Emirates. We are looking for a Palantir Foundry Engineer to join us in Abu Dhabi. This role is based in the UAE and includes relocation from Switzerland with full immigration and relocation support.

Requirements

About the Role

As one of the first members of Unit8’s team in the UAE, you will help deliver Foundry solutions for clients while contributing to the growth of our presence in the region.

You will work directly with client teams to understand their data and operational challenges, then design and build solutions that address them. The role combines hands-on engineering with close collaboration across business and technical teams. You will also contribute your technical perspective during early client discussions and help shape practical approaches to new opportunities.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, deploy and maintain data solutions using Palantir Foundry.
  • Develop and troubleshoot data pipelines and processing systems using Foundry and relevant open-source or proprietary technologies.
  • Build and maintain Foundry components such as Ontologies, pipelines, and user-facing applications.
  • Apply sound engineering practices for testing, data quality, performance, security and maintainability.
  • Work with client stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify problems and translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, product owners and client teams in an agile environment.
  • Contribute to technical discovery and solution scoping for prospective and ongoing engagements.
  • Help establish Unit8’s engineering and delivery approach in the UAE, sharing knowledge with colleagues and supporting the growth of the local team.

About You

We are looking for an experienced Palantir Foundry Engineer with a passion for data and solving complex client challenges. You should be a skilled professional who has:

* Foundry Platform Knowledge

    • Demonstrated experience with AIP, Workshop, Code repository, and Pipeline Builder.
    • A solid understanding of security concepts within Foundry, including restricted views and markings.
    • Knowledge of Ontology and Data connection.
    • We're interested in the technical details of what you've built and how you approached the architecture of your Foundry use-cases.

* Programming Skills - proficiency in Python and PySpark.

* Data Skills (Nice-to-have) - knowledge of data modeling and basic concepts of data science (classification, clustering, regression).

* Professional Experience

  • A minimum of 1 year of experience working with the Foundry platform, ideally within a larger company where you may have had a focused but deep exposure.
  • Strong client-facing skills: You are comfortable interacting with both business and technical clients, giving presentations, and possess a strong problem-solving mindset.

* Other

  • You are willing to travel to meet with our clients and the team

Benefits

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to help establish Unit8’s presence in a new market.
  • Hands-on work on client challenges with tangible business impact.
  • Exposure to different industries, projects and technologies.
  • A collaborative team environment with colleagues across Switzerland, Europe and North America.
  • Mentorship and opportunities to develop your technical and consulting skills.
  • Full immigration support for your move to the UAE.
  • Relocation support, including accommodation and travel allowances.
  • Opportunities to contribute to knowledge sharing and projects with a positive impact.

At Optics11, we build advanced sensing technology that helps protect what matters most, from critical offshore energy infrastructure to underwater security systems. Our solutions operate in complex, high-stakes environments where precision, reliability, and real-world performance are essential.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of New Product Introduction (NPI) and Field Integration, ensuring that what is developed by engineering teams can successfully operate in real-world, often offshore environments. You will play a key role in bridging the gap between development and deployment. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role in a fast-moving scale-up, where not everything is fully defined. What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end projects covering product delivery (hardware and software) and field integration, including offshore deployment

  • Coordinate across engineering, operations, supply chain, and external partners to ensure smooth execution

  • Translate ambiguous goals and requirements into clear, actionable plans

  • Drive momentum and remove blockers in fast-moving, real-world environments

  • Support bid preparation by building realistic timelines and execution strategies, even with limited information

  • Identify gaps in ways of working and proactively improve processes across teams

  • Enable a learning-oriented project environment by sharing best practices and coaching others

  • Establish feedback loops between R&D and field teams to improve product and execution quality

What’s in it for you

  • Work on products that are deployed in real-world, high-impact environments, not just concepts or internal tools

  • Operate in a fast-growing, international scale-up where you can truly influence how projects are run

  • 5–8 years of project management experience in a technical environment

  • MSc degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, Physics, or a related field

  • Hands-on experience with New Product Introduction (NPI) projects is essential

  • Proven track record of delivering projects with real-world execution (not only planning)

  • Comfortable combining structured planning with hands-on operational involvement

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think in a structured way

  • Experience with offshore or field deployment projects is a strong plus

  • Able to make decisions and move forward with incomplete information

  • Clear communicator who can align technical (R&D) and operational (field) teams

You will thrive here if you

  • Enjoy seeing projects come to life in the real world, not just in plans or presentations

  • Are comfortable navigating complexity, including on-site and offshore environments

  • Prefer progress over perfection and know how to balance speed with quality

  • Take ownership and proactively solve problems across both product and organization

jobs.description:
About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the US, using AI to connect 14 million students who are looking for scholarships with companies that are looking for students. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.


The Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled and innovative Senior Full-Stack Engineer to architect high-performance web applications and accelerate our development velocity across our B2B platform. You’ll play a pivotal role in bridging modern Nuxt 3/4 frontend applications—including customer management portals and embeddable widget engines—with a robust Laravel and Doctrine ORM backend API, delivering seamless experiences that connect millions of students to funding opportunities.

You will own the technical implementation of core products across our entire stack, working with PHP 8.2+, Laravel, MySQL, and Vue 3 / Nuxt 3/4. Beyond traditional engineering, this role champions efficiency: you will deeply integrate AI-native workflows (using tools like Cursor and Google Gemini) to double shipping velocity, automate test coverage, and build intelligent LLM-driven platform features. If you are passionate about full-stack architecture, widget infrastructure, and leveraging AI to build smarter and faster, this role is for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Full Lifecycle Development: Architect, build, and ship end-to-end B2B features across the stack- from Laravel/Doctrine JSON:API endpoints to reactive Nuxt 3/4 Vue components and server routes.

  • Embed & Analytics Engine: Develop and optimize high-performance embedded widget systems, Nitro server engine logic, iframe cross-origin messaging, client event-tracking SDKs, and data ingestion pipelines.

  • API & Database Architecture: Design robust relational database schemas (MySQL), Doctrine entity mappings, clean migrations, performant RESTful/JSON:API contracts, and Redis caching layers.

  • AI-Native Acceleration: Integrate AI coding tools (Cursor, Gemini) into daily development for rapid feature prototyping, code refactoring, test generation, and building LLM-driven product features (e.g., automated applicant evaluation).

  • Third-Party Integrations*:* Integrate and maintain core third-party services and APIs, including CRM platforms, error tracking systems, payment gateways, and cloud data services

  • Automated Testing & Quality: Establish comprehensive automated test coverage (PHPUnit for backend, Playwright and Vitest for E2E/components) integrated into CI/CD pipelines to guarantee zero regressions.

  • Mentorship & Code Reviews: Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews and collaborate closely with product managers, QA engineers, and leadership to elevate team standards.


Required Qualifications (Must Haves)

  • Experience: 4+ years of professional full-stack web development experience, with at least 1+ year actively incorporating AI coding assistants into daily engineering workflows.

  • Backend Expertise (PHP & Laravel): Strong commercial experience with PHP 8+ and Laravel (clean service architecture, queues/jobs, middleware, and OAuth2/Passport authentication).

  • Frontend Mastery (Vue 3 & Nuxt 3/4): Deep proficiency in modern Vue 3 (Composition API), Nuxt 3 or Nuxt 4, TypeScript, Pinia state management, and Tailwind CSS.

  • Database & ORM Skills: Strong relational database modeling and query optimization in MySQL, along with solid experience using ORMs (Doctrine ORM / DBAL or deep Eloquent experience with the ability to adapt to Doctrine quickly).

  • API Design & Caching: Deep understanding of RESTful / JSON:API standards, server-side validation error mapping, request formatting, and Redis performance caching.

  • AI-Native Workflow: Active daily use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Gemini) as a force multiplier for coding, debugging, and test creation.

  • Automated Testing: Hands-on experience writing backend test suites (PHPUnit) and frontend/E2E tests (Playwright, Vitest, or Cypress).

  • DevOps & Tooling: Solid working knowledge of Git, CI/CD release pipelines, Docker containerization, and Linux/container environments.

  • Async Communication & Autonomy: Exceptional written technical communication skills for authoring PRs, architectural design docs, and issue tracking; high autonomy to navigate multi-service codebases, solve complex blockers independently, and drive initiatives.

Good to Have

  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical software engineering experience.

  • Certifications*:* Advanced degree or formal certifications in Cloud Architecture, Modern Software Engineering, or AI Engineering.

  • Doctrine ORM: Direct production experience with Doctrine ORM / DBAL in Laravel environments.

  • Widget & SDK Systems: Experience developing embeddable web widgets, lightweight JavaScript tracking SDKs, iframe cross-origin communication, or browser fingerprinting.

  • Modern Tooling: Experience with Nitro server engines, Bun runtime, PrimeVue components, or streaming data into data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery).

  • Payment Gateways: Integration experience with payment processors (Stripe/Braintree) and B2B subscription billing lifecycles.

  • Gemini LLM Integration: Practical experience integrating Google Gemini models (prompt engineering, structured JSON outputs, Gemini API / SDKs).

    Bonus Skills (The "X-Factor")

    • Technical Leadership: Prior experience in a Tech Lead or Team Lead capacity—driving architectural decisions, coordinating delivery, and unblocking team members.

    • Domain Knowledge: Background in high-growth B2B SaaS platforms, grant/applicant management systems, EdTech, recruitment/ATS tools, or conversion tracking ecosystems.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Homepage
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.
  • Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.
  • Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.
  • Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.
  • You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.
  • You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.
  • You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.
  • You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.
  • You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).
  • You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

jobs.title: Product Owner BakerWare

De verbindende schakel zijn tussen klanten, business en softwareontwikkeling én bijdragen aan innovatieve softwareoplossingen die gemeenten, belastingsamenwerkingen en waterschappen helpen om hun dienstverlening continu te verbeteren? Je adviseert klanten, werkt samen met ontwikkelteams en begeleidt de ontwikkeling van gebruiksvriendelijke software die zichtbaar verschil maakt in de dagelijkse praktijk. Maak werk van deze mogelijkheden.

Wat jij doet

Als Product Owner ben jij de verbindende factor tussen onze klanten en het ontwikkelteam. Je begrijpt de uitdagingen van onze klanten, brengt behoeften in kaart en vertaalt deze naar slimme softwareoplossingen. Geen klant en geen vraagstuk is hetzelfde. Bij de ene klant ligt een plan al klaar en bij de andere klant help jij om de behoefte en mogelijkheden te ontdekken. Jij stelt de juiste vragen, denkt mee over processen en zoekt samen met de klant naar de oplossing die écht waarde toevoegt. Je bent betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkelproces. Samen met het team zorg je ervoor dat klantwensen worden vertaald naar concrete functionaliteiten en kwalitatieve software. Daarbij combineer je adviesvaardigheden, proceskennis en affiniteit met softwareontwikkeling.

Wat doe je nog meer?

  • Je adviseert klanten over procesverbetering en digitale oplossingen.

  • Je signaleert commerciële kansen en denkt mee over de verdere ontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening.

Dit krijg je

  • Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd

  • Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën?

Dit breng je mee

Je bent enthousiast, nieuwsgierig en denkt graag in mogelijkheden. Je krijgt energie van complexe vraagstukken, klantcontact en het creëren van slimme oplossingen. Je bent communicatief sterk, overtuigend en weet verschillende belangen met elkaar te verbinden.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau.

  • Ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie als Business Consultant, Product Owner, Functioneel Consultant of een vergelijkbare rol.

  • Kennis van bedrijfsprocessen en ervaring met procesoptimalisatie.

  • Affiniteit met softwareontwikkeling en digitale dienstverlening.

  • Een commerciële instelling en oog voor nieuwe kansen.

  • Een proactieve houding, eigenaarschap en het vermogen om snel te schakelen.

Je voelt je thuis in een organisatie waar ruimte is voor eigen initiatief, waar samenwerking centraal staat en waar je samen met klanten en collega’s werkt aan oplossingen die er écht toe doen.

 

Werken bij BakerWare

BakerWare is dé softwarespecialist voor Gemeenten, Belastingsamenwerkingen en Waterschappen!   • Navigate and close complex enterprise deals — build relationships with champions and decision-makers, handle objections and commercial negotiation, and drive deals through to signed contracts.

Who You'll Work With

You'll join a lean Sales team of three, including this role. Requirements

  • Strong discovery skills — you're good at getting people to talk honestly about what isn't working for them, and you can turn that into a concrete opportunity.

Nice to Have

What We Offer

  • The chance to build Recraft's enterprise retail and advertising vertical from the ground up — the accounts you land now become the reference customers and case studies for everything that follows.

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer - Berlin
jobs.description:
About RA

Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture.

Purpose of the role

As our Senior QA Engineer, you'll look after the quality of ra.co, our iOS and Android apps, and RA Scan, the app promoters use to scan tickets at the door. You'll work across five product teams. Each team writes and runs its own tests. You'll help them do it well, keep the automated test suites healthy, and test the riskiest releases yourself.

Some of what we ship carries real risk: payments, checkout, and getting people into venues on the night. Other changes are a line of copy. You'll help us tell the two apart and test each one accordingly. We use AI tools across development, and you'll help the teams use them to write better tests, faster.

Key responsibilities

  • Keep the web end-to-end test suite healthy: fix flaky tests, add coverage for new features, and make sure a failing suite gets fixed quickly
  • Grow automated testing for our iOS and Android apps and RA Scan with the app developers, so mobile tests run on every change
  • Test high-risk releases yourself, such as payments and checkout, including edge cases and what happens when things fail
  • Review the test plans teams write, and help them improve
  • Use AI tools to write and maintain tests, help developers do the same, and check what the tools produce
  • Brief our external testing partner and review the results they send back
  • Report bugs clearly, and follow them through with developers and product managers
  • Track a few simple measures, such as bugs that reach production and how reliable the automated tests are

We’re looking for

  • Several years in QA or test engineering, typically four or more, testing web and mobile products
  • Hands-on test automation: you've built and maintained automated tests that run in CI, for web (for example Playwright, Cypress or Selenium) and ideally mobile. We use XCUITest on iOS and Espresso with Kotlin on Android
  • Enough coding to write and fix tests alongside developers, in a language such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Kotlin or Swift
  • You can test APIs and check data with SQL
  • Good judgement about risk: what to test deeply, what lightly, and what not at all
  • You've used AI tools in your testing work, and know where they help and where they don't
  • Clear writing: bug reports and test plans other people can act on

If you meet most of these but not all, we'd still like to hear from you. Nobody arrives with all of it, and we'll help you grow into the rest.

Nice to have

  • CircleCI or a similar CI tool
  • Working with an external testing partner
  • Payments, checkout or ticketing systems
  • Testing apps used at live events, with poor networks
  • Test management tools such as Qase or TestRail

What we offer you

  • Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance.
  • Matched pension, or 401k for US staff.
  • Comprehensive staff wellbeing initiatives, featuring regular activities and workplace programmes to support mental and physical health. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs.
  • Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on merch.
  • Paid annual volunteering allowance, encouraging contributions to community projects and charities you care about.
  • A transparent internal company culture committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (see: https://ra.co/about/diversity).
  • Active involvement in community projects within the electronic music community (see: https://ra.co/about/community).

More about RA

We are independent and we intend to stay that way. 25 years in, RA answers to the culture it came from rather than to outside stakeholders. That is what enables us to make decisions on a long-term basis.

Our staff, contributors and international teams are not observers. They are part of the scenes we cover, and that is what we hire for. Craft first, and then a genuine stake in this music rather than just a job in it.

RA has been B Corp certified since 2024, which holds us to standards on social and environmental impact we would want to meet regardless of the badge.

We especially welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, abilities, ethnicities, experiences, gender identities, and sexual orientations.

Our values

  • Electronic music is art.
  • We celebrate the progressive values that underpin electronic music.
  • We advocate for a more inclusive and equitable electronic music community.
  • We honour the past, present and future of electronic music.
  • We use innovation to empower the community.
  • We choose honesty over gain and purpose over profit.
  • We're always front left.

Listing details

This role is a full-time, permanent position, based in Berlin. Please note: this position requires applicants to be based in Berlin and to work from the office three days per week. The annual salary range for this role is €60,000 to €72,000. If you have questions about the role, please contact
