jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.


About the Role

We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering.

Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.

You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations, lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do

Own the strategy and the stack

  • Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.

  • Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

  • Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.

  • Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on

  • Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.

  • Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.

  • Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.

  • Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM

  • Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.

  • Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.

  • Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.

  • Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical

  • Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

  • Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.

  • Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team

  • Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

  • Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.

  • Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

What Will Make You Successful

Experience

  • Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS

  • Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team

  • Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft

  • Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.

  • Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

  • Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

  • Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct

  • You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

  • You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.

  • You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have

  • Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.

  • Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.

  • Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

Why This Role

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast.

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Enterprise Account Executive job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for a ‘full-stack’ Enterprise Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that mostly focuses on large companies from Tech, Syntec, HCR, and B2B services, interacting with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Why is this segment interesting?

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers (creating multiple potential blockers), long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise AEs.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

What will you do with us?

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. In our Enterprise Sales team, you will deal with companies with more than 300 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

Take a look at this testimonial from Emilie Quellec and watch Julien Plessis, both part of the Enterprise Sales team 👀


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Enterprise team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 8 years of experience in Sales, including at least 2 years managing the whole Enterprise Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing.

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

About PlaytestCloud

PlaytestCloud’s Player Insights Platform™ helps game studios improve their games through feedback from real players. Over 60% of the top-grossing game studios have tested their games with PlaytestCloud.

🏆 Premier provider for games. We help game studios worldwide make the best games they possibly can. 

🏆 Built for player insight. We build technology that enables secure, high-quality remote game testing. 

🏆 Independent and established. We are bootstrapped and profitable, with more than 400 paying game studios and over one million playtesters.

Our player community

PlaytestCloud runs one of the largest proprietary player panels in games: a large, growing, global community of players who take part because they care about making the games they play better. 

This isn't a role where you're building a panel from scratch. You'll be advising a mature Research Operations team that's already investing in the long-term health, quality, and strategic development of that community. 

Our goal is simple: help game studios make better decisions through real player insight. You'll play a central role in keeping that community trusted, representative, engaged, and ready for what game developers need next.

About the role

We're hiring an experienced, analytical Panel Manager (f/m/d) to shape the next stage of PlaytestCloud's proprietary player panel. Your job: figure out what makes a panel strong and scalable, then turn that understanding into measurable action. You'll identify the metrics that matter most, find opportunities to improve panel quality and availability, and build a practical framework that helps us serve studios better as we grow. This is a freelance contract (3–6 months) with a clear mission: build a stronger foundation for how we measure, manage, and grow our player panel.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Panel strategy and ownership. Take ownership of the health and growth of PlaytestCloud's global player panel.

  • Metrics and insight. Define and track the metrics that connect panel performance, player experience, studio needs, and business growth.

  • Opportunity identification. Analyze panel data to find the highest-impact opportunities, constraints, and risks.

  • Actionable improvements. Turn insight into practical recommendations, and work with the right teams to implement and measure them.

  • Cross-functional collaboration. Partner closely with Research Operations, Product, and GTM to make sure the panel supports great outcomes for our studios.

  • Sustainable foundations. Set up a reporting rhythm, performance framework, and roadmap the team can keep using after the contract ends.


Your profile

Must-have:

  • Panel experience. Recent hands-on experience managing, running, growing, or optimizing a large participant panel, research-participant community, or gaming community — including participant supply, retention, quality, segmentation, and/or incentive strategy. 

  • Commercial and analytical mindset. You know how to find the few metrics that actually matter, connect them to customer and business outcomes, and use data to make good calls. 

  • Tool competency. Comfortable querying databases in SQL, and familiar with agentic AI tools like Claude or Codex. 

  • Ownership. You're a self-starter who likes taking on an ambiguous challenge, building structure around it, and driving it forward on your own. 

  • Practical problem-solving. You turn analysis into clear priorities and action, not insight for its own sake. 

  • Strong communication. You can explain complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical people alike. 

  • Strong English. Comfortable communicating in written and spoken English on a remote, international team.

Great to have:

  • Qualitative research experience. Experience supporting or working closely with qualitative user research, including participant recruitment, study operations, interviews, usability testing, or research synthesis.

  • Games and player research. Interest in games, player research, or the gaming industry. Direct games-recruitment experience is not required.

Questions about the role or our hiring process? Email our Talent team at talent[at]playtestcloud.com.

About the job

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a freelance position based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 1 day of remote work per week.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Design & Build AI Systems

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.
  • Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.
  • Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.
  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack

  • Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.
  • Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.
  • Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.
  • Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact

  • Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.
  • Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.
  • Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.
  • Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.
  • Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.
  • Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.
  • Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement

  • Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.
  • Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.
  • Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.
  • Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL

  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems
  • Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products
  • Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact
  • Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and business impact
  • Performance and reliability of AI systems
  • Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1h30 technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.
  • Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement

  • Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.
  • Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.
  • Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.
  • Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems
  • Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products
  • Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact
  • Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and business impact
  • Performance and reliability of AI systems
  • Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

jobs.description:
Werken bij een verzekeraar saai? Niet bij Univé! 

Wie ben jij

Jij bent een verbindende projectleider met sterke organisatorische vaardigheden en gevoel voor bestuurlijke verhoudingen. Je behoudt overzicht in een dynamische omgeving, neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor resultaatgebieden en weet mensen mee te nemen in verandering. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen operationeel, tactisch en strategisch niveau en creëert draagvlak bij verschillende stakeholders.

Verder beschik je over:

  • hbo/wo werk- en denkniveau;

  • minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als IT-projectleider, programmamanager of delivery lead;

  • ervaring binnen complexe enterprise IT-omgevingen;

  • kennis van Agile/Scrum en hybride projectmethodieken;

  • ervaring met stakeholdermanagement op managementniveau;

  • aantoonbare kennis van en ervaring met het begeleiden van RFI- en RFP-trajecten, inclusief requirementsvorming, marktverkenning, leveranciersselectie, beoordelingsprocessen en contractvoorbereiding;

  • affiniteit met IT-governance, servicemanagement en security/compliance;

  • sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, organisatiesensitiviteit en besluitvaardigheid.

Pré

  • ervaring binnen financiële dienstverlening of de verzekeringssector;

  • kennis van DORA, ITSM, cloudtransities, sourcingvraagstukken en aanbestedingstrajecten via RFI/RFP;

  • ervaring met OKR's en waardestroomgericht werken;

Voor deze rol zijn vooral de volgende competenties belangrijk:

Verbindend leiderschap, resultaatgerichtheid, organisatiesensitiviteit, analytisch vermogen en besluitvaardigheid. Je brengt structuur aan in complexe omgevingen, communiceert helder, creëert draagvlak en weet samenwerking tussen verschillende stakeholders effectief te organiseren.

Wat ga je doen

Als Projectleider binnen IT Kern bij Univé ben je verantwoordelijk voor het initiëren, coördineren en realiseren van organisatiebrede IT-projecten en verandertrajecten. Je opereert in een complexe omgeving waarin continuïteit, security, compliance, servicemanagement en digitale transformatie samenkomen.

Je werkt nauw samen met teammanagers, product owners, servicemanagers, architectuur, securityspecialisten, leveranciers en stakeholders binnen de Regionale Univé's.

Je zorgt ervoor dat projecten voorspelbaar, beheerst en met draagvlak worden uitgevoerd. Daarbij bewaak je de balans tussen run, change, innovatie en compliance.
Binnen IT Kern werk je aan trajecten die direct bijdragen aan de strategische beweging van Univé richting een moderne, omnichannel en toekomstbestendige IT-organisatie.

Wat ga je doen?
Als Projectleider IT Kern leid je complexe IT-projecten en verandertrajecten binnen een organisatiebrede context. Je zorgt voor een heldere projectaanpak, bewaakt voortgang, risico’s, afhankelijkheden, budget en kwaliteit, en stuurt multidisciplinaire teams aan. Je verbindt operationele IT-vraagstukken met strategische doelen en zorgt voor draagvlak bij management, CIO Office, Regionale Univé’s, leveranciers en interne IT-teams. Daarnaast begeleid je waar nodig RFI- en RFP-trajecten, van scopebepaling tot leveranciersselectie en overdracht naar implementatie.

Resultaatgebieden
De belangrijkste resultaatgebieden zijn:
Project- en teamsturing
Je stelt projectplannen op, organiseert projectteams en stuurt interne en externe betrokkenen aan op het behalen van het gewenste resultaat.
Governance en besluitvorming
Je zorgt voor duidelijke documentatie, rapportages en besluitvorming, onder andere richting stuurgroep en management.
Stakeholdermanagement
Je informeert, betrekt en verbindt stakeholders binnen IT, business, Regionale Univé’s en externe leveranciers.
Voortgang, kwaliteit en verbetering
Je bewaakt planning, capaciteit, risico’s en resultaten, evalueert projecten en draagt bij aan verbetering van projectmanagementaanpak en werkwijzen.

Algemene onderwerpen binnen de functie
Binnen de functie werk je aan thema’s die bijdragen aan een toekomstbestendige IT-organisatie, zoals IT-continuïteit, DORA en IT Assurance, security en autorisatiemanagement, cloudtransitie en sourcing. Ook spelen servicemanagement, governanceontwikkeling, waardestromen, roadmaps, OKR’s, kwartaalplanning en capaciteitsmanagement een belangrijke rol. Daarbij bewaak je steeds de balans tussen run, change, innovatie en compliance.

Wat bieden wij

Bij Univé IT bieden we je een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische organisatie. Je krijgt een rol waarin je zichtbaar bijdraagt aan de digitale transformatie van Univé en waarin je samenwerkt met gedreven professionals binnen IT Kern.

Deze functie is ingedeeld in schaal 10. De salarisrange ligt tussen € 64.830,24 en € 93.155,08 bruto per jaar op basis van een 38-urige werkweek. Dit is inclusief vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning.


De belangrijkste arbeidsvoorwaarden op een rijtje:

  • een prima salaris, afhankelijk van je opleiding, ervaring en competenties;

  • 13e maand;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • variabele Collectieve Prestatie Beloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris;

  • arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd;

  • 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek;

  • goede studiekostenregeling;

  • prima pensioenvoorziening;

  • reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en een thuiswerkvergoeding;

  • korting op je schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.

Het team heeft een fijne werkplek in Zwolle, vlakbij het station. In overleg met het team behoort 2 tot 3 dagen thuiswerken tot de mogelijkheden.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dicht bij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. We richten ons op het voorkomen van risico's, het beperken van gevolgen en het verzekeren wanneer dat nodig is. Vanuit onze coöperatieve kracht ontwikkelen we samen continu nieuwe producten, diensten en oplossingen voor onze leden.

 

Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren naar een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platformorganisatie. Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé.

 

Drie focusgebieden

De IT-organisatie is ingericht met drie primaire afdelingen op de focusgebieden Kern, Data en Distributie. De CIO Office biedt ondersteuning door richting en houvast te geven aan strategische doelen en kaders.

 

IT Kern

De afdeling IT Kern bestaat uit vier teams:

• Services - werkplekdiensten, 1e lijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy.

• Frontend Platform - applicatiemanagement van platformen die vooral het contact met onze leden ondersteunen, zoals de online omgeving, CRM en telefonie.

• Backend Platform - applicatiemanagement van platformen die de achterkantprocessen ondersteunen, zoals polis-, claim- en financiële administratie.

• Infra & Security Platform - cloud center of expertise en operationele securityactiviteiten.

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product engineer to own product areas within BJAK's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agents (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
About this role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Agentic SOC team. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job.

You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter.

In this role

  • Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production. You are trusted to take a high-level goal and turn it into a plan without close supervision.

  • Lead the design and delivery of LLM agents that plug into our SOC workflows, including tool design, prompt and context engineering, evals, and guardrails. Make sound tradeoffs on accuracy, cost, latency, and how much autonomy to give the agent versus keeping a human in the loop.

  • Drive technical design discussions in your stream and, where the work calls for it, influence architecture and standards beyond it. Set the bar for code quality, testing, and documentation on your team.

  • Ground engineering decisions in outcomes. Push back when the "why" is unclear, propose simpler or faster paths to the business result, and stay close to the security analysts and customers your agents are meant to serve.

  • Mentor engineers on your team and across the stream through pairing, code review, and design feedback. Act as a multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor.

  • Participate in hiring: interview candidates, help shape the bar, and support onboarding.

  • Contribute to a psychologically safe and outcome-oriented team culture. Lead by example in incidents and high-pressure moments.

  • The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, with a commitment to travel to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What you will need

  • 5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.

  • Depth in at least one technical area and broad competence across the stack. You have designed and shipped systems where performance, security, reliability, and maintainability all mattered, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made.

  • Experience with strongly typed languages (Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP, or similar). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our stack quickly.

  • Hands-on experience building LLM agents, with evidence they were useful. You have built and shipped at least one non-trivial LLM-powered agent or agentic workflow, in production or as a side project with real users. You can speak concretely about the design choices you made around tool use, context and state, evals, failure handling, autonomy, cost, and latency and, just as importantly, what the agent changed for the people using it.

  • Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow.

  • A track record of raising the level of engineers around you through mentoring, code review, and design feedback.

  • Strong communication skills. You can translate technical tradeoffs for engineers, product managers, and leadership, and you write designs and decisions in a way others can build on.

  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and secure development principles to build safe, trusted systems.

  • Fluency in English is a must.

What we offer

  • Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.

  • Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.

  • A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering and AI-augmented security operations: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice for both how we build and how our SOC operates.

  • Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.

  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.

  • Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.

  • We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

About Eye Security

 

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

 

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

 

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive
Financial Services Regulatory Lead H/F
jobs.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!


Why is this role important for Pennylane?

Pennylane is building Pennylane Financial Services (PFS), a newly created regulated subsidiary applying for ACPR authorisations as a payment institution and a financing company.

From day one of licensing, PFS must be able to operate in full regulatory compliance - not only through policies, but through reliable execution: clear ownership, predictable reporting routines, auditable evidence, and effective coordination across Operations, Finance/Accounting and Compliance & Risk.

This role is critical to organise and run that regulatory function, with the ambition to progressively consolidate regulatory reporting ownership within PFS.

How will you contribute to the project?

You will help build and operate the regulatory office of Pennylane Financial Services, working across Compliance & Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations and Technology.

Your initial priority will be to turn PFS’s regulatory requirements into a reliable operating framework: a complete obligations inventory, clear ownership, an integrated regulatory calendar, and effective controls over regulatory reporting and evidence.

In practice, you will:

  • maintain the authoritative inventory of PFS’s regulatory obligations;

  • coordinate the regulatory-reporting portfolio and directly produce selected returns;

  • establish clear responsibilities, reporting controls and escalation paths across contributing functions;

  • support supervisory responses and commitment tracking from day one;

  • coordinate regulatory change with Compliance, Legal and the relevant subject-matter owners; and

  • support regulatory governance through clear reporting, decision tracking and follow-through.

You will not replace the specialist accountability of Finance, the MLRO, Legal, Risk or Operations. Your role will be to make their contributions converge into a controlled, timely and inspection-ready regulatory process.

As PFS grows, you will help shape and evolve its regulatory operating model and governance arrangements.

What will your day-to-day responsibilities be?

  • Maintain the regulatory-obligations inventory: keep a complete and current view of PFS’s recurring and event-driven obligations, with clear owners, deadlines, controls, approval routes and evidence requirements.

  • Run the integrated regulatory calendar: coordinate contributors, dependencies and review milestones across Compliance & Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations and Technology, escalating delivery risks before deadlines are affected.

  • Coordinate regulatory reporting: oversee the end-to-end reporting portfolio and directly prepare selected returns, while ensuring specialist functions retain accountability for their underlying judgements and data.

  • Establish reporting controls: document and operate source-to-report lineage, reconciliations, variance analysis, maker-checker review, sign-offs, submission evidence, correction procedures and backup arrangements.

  • Coordinate data-quality remediation: document reporting-data issues, assign them to the accountable function, monitor resolution and escalate overdue or recurring problems.

  • Support supervisory responses and commitment tracking: maintain a reliable record of requests, responses and commitments; coordinate contributions and evidence under the direction of the ACPR relationship owner; and escalate delivery issues to PFS management.

  • Coordinate regulatory change: work with Compliance, Legal and relevant subject-matter owners to translate new requirements into impact assessments, accountable owners, implementation plans and evidence.

  • Support regulatory governance: prepare concise status reporting, maintain decision and action tracking, and ensure regulatory matters reach the appropriate management or governance forum.

  • Improve tools and processes: define practical requirements for workflow, evidence storage, reporting production and regulatory remittance, reducing manual effort without weakening controls.

Profile we are looking for

Must-have

  • Meaningful experience in a regulated financial environment, in one or more areas such as regulatory reporting, regulatory operations, prudential reporting, compliance, risk, finance, internal control or regulatory advisory.

  • Strong understanding of reporting controls and data quality, including reconciliations, source-to-report traceability, review and approval controls, exception management and auditable evidence.

  • Sound regulatory judgement: ability to understand a requirement, identify its practical implications, recognise when specialist Legal or Compliance input is needed, and translate conclusions into ownership, processes and controls.

  • Strong execution discipline, with a demonstrated ability to coordinate recurring deliverables, manage interdependencies and meet fixed deadlines reliably.

  • Ability to work effectively across Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations and Technology, while preserving clear accountability between functions.

  • Ability to build structured and durable ways of working—including registers, calendars, procedures, templates and knowledge bases—in an evolving environment.

  • Clear and concise written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain issues, assumptions and required decisions to senior stakeholders.

  • Professional fluency in French and English.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with ACPR reporting, supervisory interactions or the French regulatory environment.

  • Experience in a payment institution, electronic-money institution, financing company, bank, regulated fintech, supervisory authority or specialist advisory firm.

  • Exposure to more than one regulatory domain, such as payments, prudential reporting, statistical reporting, AML-CFT, fraud, incidents or financing activities.

  • Experience coordinating regulatory change, supervisory requests, inspections or remediation commitments.

  • Familiarity with regulatory-remittance tools, reporting-data lineage, workflow automation or evidence-management solutions.

  • Experience building or materially improving a regulatory framework in a new entity, licensing programme or operating-model transformation.

Recruitment Process

1. Interview with Simon (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Laurent (1h), Compliance&Risk Director

3. Case Study with two Finance or Legal representative (1h)

4. Team fit with two interviewers (30 min)

5. Last round with Maxime and Felix (45 min)

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

jobs.title: GM, Sales (EMEA)
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Opportunity

Deepgram is expanding into EMEA, and we're seeking a GM, Sales to own the region — building and leading the Enterprise and commercial segments of our Account Executive team, establishing Deepgram's European home in London, and driving growth across the region.

This role is both strategic and hands-on. You'll work with sales leadership to continue optimizing the systems, playbooks, and culture that scale ARR growth, while developing a high-performing team that converts opportunities into long-lasting customers. A core part of your mission is building Deepgram's next generation of sales talent through world-class training, coaching, and structured career development.

You'll also be more than a revenue leader. As our senior-most voice in EMEA, you'll bring what you learn in the field back into the company and shape what we build — regional product-market fit, roadmap priorities, and the technical requirements European enterprises hold us to.

You'll partner closely with Marketing, Sales Leadership, RevOps, Customer Success, and Product to align pipeline strategy and leverage modern AI tools to boost productivity, personalization, and team efficiency. Equal parts operator, coach, and builder, you'll combine data-driven rigor with creativity to shape how Deepgram grows its customer base and its sales talent.

What You'll Do

  • Scale the Region: Own the EMEA number. Build and execute a strategic roadmap to drive hyper-growth in ARR, from initial land to enterprise-wide expansion.

  • Open London: Stand up Deepgram's London office as our EMEA hub — and treat it as a commercial asset, not just real estate. It will host customer and developer events, executive briefings, partner sessions, and the team you build.

  • "Challenge & Lead": Recruit and mentor a high-performance team of Account Executives. Manage Customer Success, Marketing, and Forward Deployed Engineers in a dotted-line structure. You will instill a culture of "Challenger" selling — teaching AEs how to disrupt legacy incumbents and lead with technical ROI.

  • Shape the Product: Act as the voice of EMEA inside Deepgram. Translate field signal — deal losses, evaluation criteria, data residency and compliance requirements, language and accent coverage — into specific, prioritized input that changes what we build and when.

  • Build the Ecosystem: Identify and sign strategic regional partners, GSIs, and local resellers to act as a force multiplier for Deepgram's direct sales efforts.

  • Operational Excellence: Implement rigorous forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and territory management across multiple countries, languages, and buying cultures. You will bridge the gap between London and our US HQ.

  • C-Suite Influence: Act as the primary executive sponsor for major regional accounts, navigating complex procurement cycles and technical AI evaluations.

You'll Love This Role If You

  • Thrive on building and scaling high-performing teams that consistently beat targets.

  • Want to build something from the ground up — including the office, the team, and the regional playbook.

  • Value working with tenured, high-caliber leaders who prioritize clarity, accountability, collaboration, and execution.

  • Enjoy blending data-driven sales operations with creative, human-centered leadership.

  • Are energized by developing AEs and building a culture of growth and continuous learning.

  • Believe in the power of AI to transform productivity, and are eager to harness cutting-edge tools to optimize performance.

  • Are passionate about Deepgram's mission to redefine what's possible with speech technology.

It's Important to Us That You Have

  • Experience: 12+ years in B2B SaaS sales, with 5+ years in a senior leadership role (Director/VP) covering EMEA — including the UK and at least one of DACH, the Nordics, France, or Southern Europe.

  • The "Deepgram DNA": A deep fascination with AI, LLMs, and API-first products. You should be comfortable discussing technical architecture as easily as you discuss revenue targets.

  • Product Influence: You've done more than sell — you've changed what your company built. You can point to specific roadmap decisions, features, or product bets that happened because of how you brought the market back to Product and Engineering.

  • Proven Growth: A track record of scaling a regional business from early traction to high-scale maturity ($10M+ ARR growth experience preferred).

  • Partnership Prowess: Demonstrable experience building channel programs that significantly contribute to the total revenue mix.

  • High ASP Focus: Expertise in value-based selling to increase Average Selling Price and win rates in a competitive technical landscape.

  • Operational Rigor: Deep familiarity with modern sales stacks (Salesforce, Gong, Clari, etc.) and a commitment to data-driven decision-making.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree required; MBA or technical degree is a plus.

It Would Be Great If You Had

  • Experience opening a new office or first in-region presence for a US-headquartered company.

  • Experience leading AE organizations at a high-growth, Series B+ startup or scaling tech company.

  • Background selling developer tools, infrastructure, or AI/ML technologies.

  • Fluency in navigating EU data protection and AI regulation as a commercial topic, not just a legal one.

  • Expertise in building talent development programs or performance coaching frameworks.

  • Comfort operating in dynamic, fast-moving environments with evolving goals and systems.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Search & AI
Associate II, Product Operations
jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Krak is Kraken's consumer banking and payments product — a fast-moving team building the card, payments, and financial features that bring crypto to everyday life. The Krak Product Operations team sits at the heart of this, making sure the business can move quickly without getting blindsided by compliance, risk, vendor, or operational dependencies.

This is one of two roles in Krak’s Product Ops function, reporting to the Manager, Product Ops - Krak. You'll bring leadership to the day-to-day, working directly with compliance, legal, fraud, client engagement (CE), and external vendors to make sure new features land safely and successfully.

 

The opportunity

Product Ops at Krak is a co-ordination and intelligence function. Your job is to make sure that the cross-functional dependencies that could slow or derail delivery are surfaced early, actively managed, and resolved. You'll also help the team make better product decisions by curating the right operational data and bringing market and vendor intelligence into the room.

You'll work across four areas: compliance and risk co-ordination, third party vendor management, responding to management information (MI) and feature performance, and strategic market intelligence. Your job is to make sure the right conversations happen at the right time, and that nothing falls through the cracks on the way to launch.

 

Compliance & risk co-ordination

  • Maintain live, product-specific trackers of open compliance and legal items, including DRIs, status, and upcoming milestones

  • Triage new features against regulatory requirements ahead of development; ensure sign-off is built into delivery milestones

  • Work closely with fraud leads to ensure fraud controls and risk/velocity rules are factored into feature design (card, third party payments, and others)

  • Ensure fraud and CE teams are operationally positioned - with the right tooling, admin access, battlecards, and support articles - ahead of new product and feature launches

  • Support incident response for product-related issues and ensure post-incident reviews feed into product changes

     

Third party vendor management

  • Maintain product-specific vendor trackers covering status, open actions, key contacts, and upcoming milestones

  • Own the cadence for performance reviews with key vendors and track actions to closure

  • Maintain a working view of vendor roadmaps and capabilities; produce periodic briefings on where vendor developments create product opportunities or constraints

 

Responding to MI & feature performance

  • Ensure experiments and feature launches are supported by readily available fraud, dispute, and CE metrics alongside commercial KPIs

  • Interpret fraud, dispute, CE, and auth/decline data to identify emerging issues and surface them to the right teams

  • Drive follow-through on cross-functional findings - whether that's a compliance flag or a vendor issue

 

Strategic market intelligence

  • Scan the market for competitors' changes to features, pricing, and risk positioning

  • Monitor regulatory and market developments that could affect the Krak roadmap

  • Identify third party vendor capabilities that could enable features not yet on the roadmap; flag where the current stack may be a constraint

 

What you bring

  • 3-5 years experience in a product operations, strategy, or programme management role in a consumer fintech, payments, or banking business - ideally at a company with a card or payments product

  • Strong working knowledge of the regulatory and compliance landscape for consumer financial products in one of more regions

  • Experience working alongside or within fraud and risk functions; understanding of how fraud controls interact with product design

  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams with different stakeholders and different cadences, without dropping the ball

  • Track record of turning complex operational data into clear, actionable MI for product and leadership teams

  • Structured thinker who's comfortable in the detail but can step back and see the bigger picture

  • Strong communicator - able to translate between the worlds of compliance, risk, engineering, and product

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience with card issuing programmes (scheme rules, chargeback processes, fraud typologies)

  • Familiarity with third party banking and payments vendors (e.g. BIN sponsors, scheme processors, TPP aggregators)

  • Prior experience in a fast-scaling consumer fintech or neobank

  • Exposure to crypto or digital assets products

Our commitment

jobs.title: Senior Customer Experience Designer
jobs.description:
About Optics11

Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

The Role

As Senior Customer Experience Designer you will build a deep understanding of the use of both our hardware and software we supply to our defense partners and clients. You will be at the forefront of exploring, researching, and shaping the experiences that define our products, ensuring our unique technology not only meets but anticipates user needs across the complex, high-stakes defense industry. You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with Product Management, R&D, Engineering, Data science, Software, Sales, Projects and Application Engineering teams.

In your role no two weeks will look the same. You might join an Application Engineer in the field, interview technicians, map a maintenance journey, test a demo flow, or work with Product and R&D to turn customer insights into practical hardware and software improvements. You will own how we understand and improve the end-to-end customer experience, ensuring real user needs guide decisions across technical, product and commercial teams.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will establish a shared, evidence-based view of our customers through clear personas, journey maps, research practices and a structured insight repository. You will identify key experience gaps, introduce repeatable ways to validate new ideas and translate customer needs into product priorities—reducing development risk and helping us deliver technology customers can trust in demanding, high-stakes environments.


Key Responsibilities

• Lead customer and user research by planning and conducting qualitative, quantitative, and field studies across installation, operation, and maintenance, translating findings into product and design decisions. For example, by joining our application engineers in the field to do research

• Own customer journey and service design by mapping end-to-end customer experiences and supporting internal processes, designing repeatable hardware and software demo flows, and facilitating workflow validation with responsible teams.

• Develop personas and manage customer insights by leading the persona lifecycle, maintaining a central research repository, providing reusable research frameworks, and synthesizing learnings collected across the organization.

• Translate customer needs into product solutions by creating product/service blueprints, journey maps, experience maps, prototypes, and workflow diagrams, and by collaborating with Product and R&D on hardware and software recommendations.

• Validate and measure customer experience outcomes by testing whether features meet defined user needs and success criteria before and


• Master’s degree in engineering or design, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of experience in Customer / User Experience Research, with a proven track record of conducting research in technical fields, preferably in defense, or similar industries.

• Strong understanding of both hardware and software products, particularly in complex and regulated environments, e.g., industrial environments.

• Proficiency in qualitative and quantitative research methods and tools, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of conveying research findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Demonstrated critical thinking, adaptability to challenges, and a problem-solving mindset to creatively address user pain points.

• Proficiency in industry standard tooling for user experience research and visualization such as Jira Product Discovery, Dovetail, Miro, Figma

• Willingness to travel and do field research.

• Drivers’ license B (or international equivalent)

Nice to Have

• Experience in defense industry or another industrial high-tech / high compliance environment

• Experience in design leadership, system architecture, and design quality management

• Proficiency in Dutch language is a plus


Security screening

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please check:
