jobs.title: Senior Influence Manager (m/w/d)
Frontend Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a Frontend Lead Engineer to own the front end at Omnea.

Our design system is growing fast, our front-end architecture is becoming more complex, and right now ownership of these things is distributed. You'd be the person who takes this to the next level.

You'll work across every product team. You'll own the design system, own the front-end architecture, and set the standard for how we build interfaces. We're a tight-knit group of ambitious builders who hold the bar high. It took over 10,000 interviews to hire our first 50 Omneans. Over the next year, our engineering team will double in size, our enterprise customer base will grow from ~180 to 300+, and revenue will triple. The front end has to scale with it.

This is a craft role with real leverage. Almost every engineer at Omnea ships front end. What you build determines how well they do it.

Procurement is a harder interface problem than it sounds. Approval workflows that branch and re-route, dense tables people live in all day, intake forms that adapt to what someone is buying. Getting this right is the difference between software people tolerate and software people actually like using.

What Can You Expect On Our Engineering Team?

  • Join a Skilled Team. Become part of one of Europe's fastest-growing software companies, working alongside experienced full-stack product engineers and product designers from top technology businesses and startups.

  • Own the Design System. You'll own our design system outright: components, patterns, tokens, documentation, and adoption. You'll partner closely with Design to turn intent into reusable, high-quality primitives.

  • Own the Front-End Architecture. Deployment strategy, performance, build tooling, and the conventions everyone else follows. You'll set the direction rather than inherit it, working alongside the engineers and designers closest to each surface rather than owning it in isolation.

  • Leverage Across Every Team. You'll work with all of our engineering teams on their most front-end-heavy projects. The work you do multiplies across the whole org.

  • A Real Design Partnership. Every cross-functional team at Omnea has a dedicated Product Manager and Product Designer. You'll be the connective tissue between design intent and what actually ships, and the person designers come to when they want to know what's possible.

  • Work with Modern Technology. TypeScript everywhere, React and Next.js on the front end, and Meticulous for automated visual regression testing, so you can refactor the design system without fear. Behind it sits Postgres and AWS serverless infrastructure (Lambda, DynamoDB, and EventBridge), managed through Pulumi and deployed via GitHub Actions, with Datadog for observability.

  • AI-Native Development. AI is core to how we build. Engineers use Claude Code and agentic workflows every day to write, review, and ship code faster, and our product is itself built on AI agents that automate complex procurement workflows.

  • Continuous Delivery. We deploy small, incremental changes to production multiple times per day, enabling rapid iteration and fast customer feedback loops.

  • Collaboration and Autonomy. We operate as a high-trust team where individuals are expected to take ownership while collaborating closely to solve difficult problems.

  • Customers at the Center. We regularly engage directly with customers to understand their problems, gather feedback, and ensure we're building products that create genuine value.


About You

  • You're deep in React. You've built complex, production React applications and you understand the framework properly, not just the API surface. Rendering behaviour, state, performance, and where things break at scale.

  • You've owned front-end infrastructure. Rendering strategies, build tooling, bundle performance, and the architectural decisions underneath a large application.

  • You've built or owned a design system. Not just consumed one. You've made the calls on component APIs, driven adoption across teams, and dealt with the messy reality of migration and versioning.

  • You have taste. You care how things look and feel, you notice when something is only 90% right, and you can hold a genuine conversation with designers rather than just implementing tickets.

  • You know CSS deeply. Layout, styling architecture, and building interfaces that hold up across breakpoints, themes, and edge cases. You treat accessibility and motion as part of the craft rather than a checklist at the end.

  • You're a strong engineer first. Your depth and your interest sit in the front end, and that's the point of this role. But you're fluent in TypeScript generally and comfortable working beyond the browser when a problem calls for it.

  • You're motivated by impact. You care about what your work actually achieves, not just how it's built. You thrive with the autonomy to make meaningful decisions and take real ownership of outcomes.

  • You're a team builder. You're excited by maximising team performance, whether that means learning from others or taking the time to explain, give feedback, and level up those around you.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. This role is new. Its shape will be partly yours to define, and you're happy tackling problems without a predefined solution, backed by an experienced team.


Nice-to-Haves

  • You've worked at design-led companies or somewhere with a genuinely high bar for interface quality.

  • You've performed exceptionally at something else, be it academics, sport, or work. You've gone above and beyond the norm.

  • You love engineering. It's more than a job. You've contributed to open source or worked on side projects just because you enjoy it.


Interview Process

Before applying, we strongly encourage you to spend a few minutes in our R&D Candidate Hub. It covers our engineering culture, ways of working, interview process, tech environment, and what it's like to build at Omnea.

>> R&D Candidate Hub: https://omnea.notion.site/R-D-Candidate-Hub-2f688cce658780f1b942c81cd3a032d4

While this is a front-end specialist role, we expect a core level understanding of TypeScript beyond the browser, so you should be comfortable writing general TypeScript in an exercise that will feel more full-stack than front-end. We assess this as part of our pair programming stage, which is the same standard exercise we run for every engineer. Beyond that baseline, we're looking for genuine depth in React, front-end architecture, and design systems.

The process varies slightly by level but generally includes:

  1. Initial screening call with the Talent team (30 mins - remote)

  2. Pair programming interview in TypeScript (1 hour - remote)

  3. Onsite Interviews: front-end system design , engineering culture, engineering leadership interviews (3 hours - in-person)

  4. Final interview with our CEO - meet Ben Freeman (CEO & Founder) - 45 mins remote

We'll assess level throughout and align interview stages accordingly.

We're proud to support visa sponsorship for candidates who need it.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

Senior Manager, HR Operations
Lead Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren software engineer of architect die inhoudelijk sterk wil blijven, maar ook graag een team verder brengt?

Bij adesso Nederland zoeken we een Lead Software Engineering. Iemand die technologie, mensen en delivery bij elkaar brengt. Je bent niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van je team, maar blijft zelf dicht bij de inhoud en onze klanten.

Je werkt met ervaren software engineers aan uitdagende klantomgevingen en helpt tegelijkertijd onze Software Engineering-practice verder uit te bouwen. Van Java en moderne frontendtechnologie tot cloud, architectuur en agentic software engineering.

Geen rol waarin je alleen maar gaat managen dus. Je blijft onderdeel van het vak.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Lead Software Engineering geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 5 tot 12 consultants en developers. Je coacht collega's, helpt ze groeien en zorgt ervoor dat zij op projecten zitten die passen bij hun kennis, ervaring en ontwikkeling.

Tegelijkertijd ben je betrokken bij onze klanten en projecten. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van delivery, denkt mee over architectuur en engineeringvraagstukken en springt bij wanneer een project inhoudelijk of organisatorisch extra aandacht nodig heeft.

Je rol bestaat grofweg uit vier onderdelen:

People & team
Je voert 1-op-1's, begeleidt ontwikkeling en performance en helpt collega's bij hun volgende stap. Je zorgt voor een goede onboarding van nieuwe collega's en bent actief betrokken bij recruitment en selectie.

Software Engineering & delivery
Je blijft inhoudelijk betrokken bij software engineering en kunt zelf een leidende rol pakken op een technisch of architectuurvraagstuk. Je bewaakt kwaliteit, planning en risico's en zorgt dat onze teams voorspelbaar en professioneel leveren.

Tegelijkertijd help je engineers zich ontwikkelen richting Agentic Engineering: minder tijd besteden aan het produceren van code en meer aan het definiëren van context, architectuur en kwaliteit, het orkestreren van agents en het reviewen en valideren van de output.

Klanten & commercie
Je ziet wat er bij klanten speelt en vertaalt dat naar kansen voor adesso. Je denkt mee in presales, voorstellen en bids en helpt oplossingen vorm te geven die technisch én commercieel kloppen. Bij bestaande klanten herken je mogelijkheden voor vervolgprojecten en uitbreiding.

Daarbij verschuift de focus steeds meer van het leveren van capaciteit naar het realiseren van engineering outcomes: sneller bouwen, moderniseren en klanten helpen hun engineeringorganisatie toekomstbestendig te maken.

Groei van onze Software Engineering-practice
Je helpt bepalen welke kennis, technologie en capabilities we als team nodig hebben. Je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen onder andere Java, frontend, cloud, architectuur en Agentic Engineering en vertaalt die naar onze manier van werken.

Je helpt daarmee niet alleen individuele engineers groeien, maar bouwt mee aan een schaalbare engineering capability binnen adesso.


We zoeken geen klassieke people manager die de techniek inmiddels heeft losgelaten. We zoeken juist iemand die software engineering begrijpt én mensen kan meenemen in de ontwikkeling van het vak.

Je hebt ruime ervaring binnen software engineering en hebt bijvoorbeeld gewerkt als Senior Software Engineer, Tech Lead, Lead Developer of Software Architect. Je hebt ervaring met Java en/of moderne software-architecturen en begrijpt wat nodig is om complexe softwareprojecten succesvol te leveren.

Daarnaast:

  • heb je circa 7–8 jaar of meer relevante ervaring binnen softwareontwikkeling en complexe projecten;

  • heb je ervaring met het begeleiden, coachen of aansturen van andere engineers;

  • kun je met zowel developers als klanten en management schakelen;

  • begrijp je onderwerpen als delivery, capaciteit, kwaliteit en projectmarge;

  • heb je ervaring binnen consultancy of projectmatige dienstverlening, of voel je je thuis in zo'n omgeving;

  • vind je het interessant om mee te bouwen aan proposities, presales en klantrelaties;

  • volg je ontwikkelingen rondom AI, AI-agents en Agentic Engineering;

  • beheers je de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed.

Certificeringen op het gebied van Java, cloud, architectuur of software engineering zijn mooi meegenomen, maar voor ons zijn je ervaring en wat je daadwerkelijk hebt gebouwd en geleid belangrijker.

Waarom deze rol interessant is

Dit is een rol voor iemand die op een punt is gekomen waarop alleen zelf software bouwen niet meer genoeg is, maar die óók niet de hele dag in managementmeetings wil zitten.

Je krijgt de ruimte om een team te ontwikkelen, invloed te hebben op onze technische richting, met klanten aan tafel te zitten én zelf inhoudelijk relevant te blijven.

adesso Nederland is met ongeveer 100 collega's compact genoeg om echt invloed te hebben, terwijl je onderdeel bent van een internationale organisatie met meer dan 13.000 collega's. Daardoor combineren we korte lijnen en ondernemerschap met de kennis, klanten en mogelijkheden van een grote Europese IT-organisatie.

En Software Engineering verandert snel. AI-agents gaan steeds meer onderdelen van de software lifecycle ondersteunen, van requirements en architectuur tot development, testing en delivery. Daardoor verschuift het werk van engineers naar het definiëren van context, architectuur en kwaliteit, en het orkestreren, beoordelen en bijsturen van AI. 

Binnen adesso willen we daar niet vanaf de zijlijn naar kijken. Als Lead Software Engineering help je mede bepalen hoe we deze ontwikkeling vertalen naar onze engineers, onze projecten en onze klanten.

Klaar om niet alleen goede software te bouwen, maar ook het team eromheen sterker te maken? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

jobs.description:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

Your Role

As the Head of UX at RoomPriceGenie, you'll lead our small but mighty design and research team of two product designers and one user researcher.

This isn't an IC role where you'll be pushing pixels or running sessions yourself. It's a leadership role focused on building the function, championing the team, and setting them up for success.

You'll set the strategic direction for how design and research operates, advocate for the team at leadership level, and create the conditions for your people to do their best work. You'll also play a key role in raising design and research maturity across the wider product organisation — guiding better decisions through clearer systems, guidelines, and shared insight.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership Representation & Advocacy

  • Champion design and research as a strategic partner that shapes the roadmap.

  • Partner with Product Leadership to translate strategic business priorities into a clear, sequenced roadmap for Design & Research.

Strategic Direction & Vision

  • Set a clear vision for the design and research function — defining what success looks like, where it's heading, and how it contributes to the company's overall strategy.

  • Raise design and research maturity by providing constructive critique and quality oversight to support high-quality product outcomes.

  • Create the space for the team to work on foundational initiatives that scale team impact. For example: evolving the component library into a robust design system and establishing clear design and content playbooks to drive consistency, efficiency, and quality.

AI Operations & Enablement

  • Set the strategic direction for how AI fits into the design & research workflow — where it accelerates, where craft stays human, and set clear guardrails for how the wider org uses it.

  • Foster a culture where the team integrates AI into product work — evolving their craft and building fluency through practice.

  • Ensure designers and researchers play a key role in shaping product and AI direction, grounding decisions in user insight and design perspective.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Advocate for Design Thinking to be embedded throughout the product life cycle, shaping ideas and guiding decisions.

  • Proactively identify large, strategic UX opportunities that span across the product.

  • Navigate competing priorities between leadership direction and team capacity, ensuring the team stays focused on high-impact work.

Team Development & Coaching

  • Provide ongoing coaching, mentoring, and constructive feedback through regular one-to-ones — focused on the development and growth of your team.

  • Build clear career frameworks and progression paths for Design and Research.

  • Encourage continuous learning, adaptability, and development within the team.

Your Profile

  • A genuine understanding of both design and research disciplines, even if your background leans more toward one. You don't need to be an expert in both, but you need to value and support both equally.

  • Proven experience in a senior design leadership role is required — you've owned a function, led teams of designers and researchers, and have a track record of influencing product direction at the leadership level.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager Italien (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Unser Projekt für dich:

moebel.de ist Europas führender Preisvergleich für Möbel und Einrichtung. Mit unserer Portalfamilie sind wir in neun europäischen Ländern aktiv, darunter Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien, die Niederlande und Polen.

Jetzt legen wir in Italien richtig los: mobi24.it ist live – unser Preisvergleich für Möbel, Einrichtung, Garten und Dekoration sowie Weiße Ware und Haushaltselektronik. Der Launch ist geschafft, die Technik läuft. Über das Tempo entscheiden jetzt die Händler: Je mehr relevante Shops mit ihren Sortimenten auf mobi24.it vertreten sind, desto stärker der Vergleich für die Nutzer und desto schneller wächst das Portal.

Das ist kein Vertrieb aus einer gepflegten Bestandsliste. Du übernimmst einen frisch gestarteten Markt und baust das Partnerportfolio auf, das mobi24.it trägt. Wer hier in den nächsten Monaten liefert, prägt, wie moebel.de in Italien aussieht.

Dafür suchen wir dich als Senior Sales Manager Italien (m/w/d).


Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben

  • Marktaufbau: Du baust das Partnerportfolio von mobi24.it auf – vom Erstkontakt über Pitch und Verhandlung bis zum Vertrag. Zielgruppe sind italienische Online-Händler aus Möbel, Einrichtung, Garten, Dekoration, Weiße Ware, Haushaltselektronik und Elektrokleingeräte.

  • Performance-Modell verkaufen: Du erklärst Händlern, wie sich mobi24.it als zusätzlicher Kanal rechnet – über Klickpreise, Sichtbarkeit, Feed-Qualität und Kosten-Umsatz-Relation.

  • Bis zum Livegang begleiten: Produktdatenfeed, Tracking, Sortimentsprüfung – gemeinsam mit dem Team in Hamburg. Danach übernimmt unser Relationship Management die laufende Betreuung, du konzentrierst dich auf neue Partner.

  • Präsenz im Markt: Händlerbesuche, Messen und Branchenevents in Italien. In einem jungen Markt entsteht Vertrauen im persönlichen Gespräch.

  • Ohr im Markt: Wettbewerb, Preisniveau, Erwartungen italienischer Händler, Saisonalitäten – deine Erkenntnisse fließen in Produkt, Pricing und Priorisierung ein.


Deine Stärken

  • Mehrjährige Vertriebserfahrung im italienischen E-Commerce, idealerweise bei Preisvergleich, Marktplatz, Affiliate-Netzwerk oder Performance-Marketing-Anbieter
  • Ein belastbares Netzwerk zu italienischen Händlern aus unseren Kategorien, das du ab Tag eins nutzt
  • Sicherheit im Performance-Modell: CPC, CPO, Affiliate, Produktdatenfeeds, ROAS und KUR sind für dich Argumente, keine Buzzwords
  • Hunter-Mentalität: Du hältst deine Pipeline eigenständig voll, auch per Kaltakquise, und bringst Abschlüsse über die Linie
  • Lust auf Aufbauarbeit: Tempo und offene Fragen reizen dich mehr als ein fertig bestelltes Feld
  • Zahlenbasiertes Arbeiten und saubere CRM-Pflege als Grundlage deiner Steuerung
  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Italiens und für regelmäßige Termine in Hamburg
  • Italienisch verhandlungssicher, Englisch sicher im Arbeitsalltag – Deutsch ist ein Plus, keine Voraussetzung


Unser Angebot

Dein Tagesablauf gehört dir

Arbeite dann, wenn du am produktivsten bist. Ob Früh- oder Spätaufsteher: Bei uns passt du deine Arbeitszeiten flexibel an – in enger Abstimmung mit deinem Team. Zeitweise Arbeiten aus dem europäischen Ausland? Kein Problem. Dein Laptop ist dein Arbeitsplatz.

Unsere Kultur ist einmalig

Hier sitzen alle auf derselben Couch – unabhängig von Titel oder Rolle. Teamspirit leben wir digital und vor Ort, z. B. bei Gaming Nights, Workouts, Filmabenden oder Teamevents.

Viermal im Jahr treffen wir uns zur Company Week

Gemeinsam im Büro arbeiten, Projekte pushen, Pizzabende genießen und mit einer Party abschließen.

Mitten in Hamburg

Bei deinen Aufenthalten in Hamburg erwartet dich unser Büro zentral zwischen Hauptbahnhof, Mönckebergstraße und Binnenalster – perfekt für Lunch-Dates, Pausen an der Alster oder einen Feierabendbummel.


Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Hosting Services
Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

Pleo's Intelligence function covers the full analytical picture - product behaviour, GTM performance, commercial data science, financial reporting, and operational intelligence. The Analytics Engineers who serve these teams own the data modelling layer that all of it runs on: dbt models, metric definitions, and semantic layer contributions that analysts, product teams, and AI tools depend on to get consistent, trustworthy answers.

You'll be embedded in the Product Intelligence team, building the tracking, experimentation, and data modelling foundations that make product data trustworthy and self-serve. You'll join a close-knit team actively migrating our analytics stack onto a new Analytics Warehouse and Omni, moving off legacy tools like Looker and Hippocampus. If you want to build the infrastructure that other people's product decisions run on rather than just report on what exists, this is the opportunity for you.

Who you'll work with and reporting to

You will report to an Analytics Manager leading Product Intelligence and Growth Intelligence. You'll partner closely with Product Managers, Product Analysts, and Engineering to get tracking, experimentation, and metric definitions right from the ground up. You'll also engage with the broader Analytics Engineering community across Pleo to drive shared standards, especially around the semantic layer that keeps metrics consistent across the organization.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain dbt models in our new Analytics Warehouse, using a clean, layered architecture and migrating logic off legacy tools as you go.

  • Own tracking plan implementation and QA directly in Segment and Amplitude in close partnership with Product and Engineering.

  • Support experimentation by modelling assignment and outcome data into structured formats that analysts and PMs can query directly.

  • Define and document metrics in our semantic layer, ensuring a single authoritative definition so downstream BI tools and AI applications yield consistent answers.

  • Apply AI-augmented data modelling practices as a standard part of how you write, review, and migrate code.

  • Partner with Product Managers and Analysts to turn one-off questions into durable, reusable data models.

  • Maintain data quality in your domain through dbt tests, freshness SLAs, and proactive monitoring.

What you bring

  • Solid SQL and dbt experience, with a clear comfort owning models end to end.

  • Working knowledge of event-based tracking tools like Segment or Amplitude.

  • Experience with Git-based development workflows, including opening and reviewing pull requests.

  • Clear communication skills to explain data definitions and structures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Genuine day-to-day use of AI tooling as part of your standard coding and workflow routine.

  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and untangling legacy logic to build modern foundations.

This role is NOT a good fit if

  • You only want to write dashboards without touching or owning the underlying data models.

  • You require rigid processes and heavy upfront structure before taking initiative.

  • You prefer to avoid data migration, cleanup work, and legacy system refactoring.

Your first 6 months

  • Ramp up: Master our dbt project structure, tracking plans, and migration roadmap while shipping small, reviewed code changes early on.

  • Take ownership: Own a dedicated slice of the migration, such as an event domain or our core experimentation data models.

  • Drive consistency: Establish semantic layer definitions for your domain so analysts and PMs can self-serve accurate metrics without custom workarounds.

Our tech stack context

  • Data warehouse: GCP / BigQuery (new Analytics Warehouse)

  • Transformation: dbt

  • Orchestration: Airflow

  • Tracking and Oroduct Analytics: Segment, Amplitude

  • BI and Analytics: Omni (migrating off legacy Looker and Hippocampus)

  • Languages: SQL

     

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days—enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office.

  • Comprehensive private healthcare depending on your location (coverage options include Vitality, Alan, or Médis).

  • 25 days of annual holiday plus public holidays, with the option to purchase 5 additional days through salary sacrifice.

  • Flexible working options supporting both hybrid and fully remote setups.

  • Free mental health and well-being support through MyndUp.

  • Generous paid parental leave policies to support growing families.

The interview process

  1. Intro Call: 30 minutes with our Talent Partner

  2. SQL Test: Completed via CoderPad

  3. Hiring Manager Interview: 45 minutes with our Data & Analytics Manager

  4. Team Interview & Live Case: Data modelling case via CodeSignal

  5. Final Interview: 30 minutes with our VP of Data & AI

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired an Analytics Engineer, we received a total of 173 applications but only 10 were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: it was very clear that many of the CVs we saw were very generic and AI generated. There is no issue with leveraging AI to help with CV writing, there was little indication of what real impact the candidates had in their previous experience. You might have heard of the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit Laszlo Bock ~2014), this is a great way to give a clear picture of what you have actually worked on. Some link or quick description of the companies you’ve worked with is also a great help.

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: there was misunderstanding about the type of experience we expect from an Analytics Engineer and we received many applications from candidates who had never been exposed to a product-led environment or had been exclusively focused on SQL/dbt work when we’re looking for both technical and stakeholders management and team collaboration experience. To be perfectly clear, this is NOT a Data Engineer role or a Data Analyst role! This is a heavily-driven dbt modelling role, experience in this area is critical. We’ve taken great care in writing this role description to reflect the reality of the job as best as possible, please ensure you read it carefully and highlight on your CV the experience relevant to what we are looking for.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Product Security Engineering ist von der bestehenden SecOps- bzw. Information-Security-Funktion abgegrenzt. Die Funktion verantwortet die Ergebnisse im Bereich Product Security Engineering und das Betriebsmodell für diese Arbeit. Sie ersetzt weder die Governance durch InfoSec noch die Verantwortung der Engineering-Domänen, die Freigabe durch Quality oder Product Operations.


  • Entwickle und leite eine risikobasierte Product-Security-Roadmap für Commerce Core, Services und weitere Produktbereiche. Sorge für eine ausgewogene Gewichtung von Prävention, Erkennung, Incident-Bereitschaft und Behebung.

  • Verantworte das Modell für Eingang und Triage von Product-Security-Findings aus externen Meldungen, Bug-Bounty-Programmen, Penetrationstests, Dependency-Sicherheitshinweisen, internen Entdeckungen und Nacharbeiten zu Sicherheitsvorfällen. Vereinbare Schweregrade und Reaktionsziele mit den Domänenverantwortlichen und InfoSec, leite jeden Vorgang an den zuständigen Code Owner weiter und mache die laufenden Reaktionsfristen sichtbar.

  • Arbeite selbst aktiv mit: Erstelle Threat Models für sicherheitskritische Änderungen, prüfe risikoreiche Designs, untersuche Schwachstellen und implementiere besonders wirksame Sicherheitskontrollen in gemeinsam genutzten Produktkomponenten oder entwickle sie gemeinsam mit anderen.

  • Etabliere wiederholbare Vorgehensweisen für sicheres Design, Sicherheitsreviews, Tests von Missbrauchsszenarien, Dependency- und Code-Scanning, die Offenlegung von Schwachstellen und Incident-Bereitschaft.

  • Koordiniere produktübergreifende Sicherheitsarbeit über eine vereinbarte Dokumentation: GHSA für Angaben zur Offenlegung, ein privates GitHub-Issue oder Epic für Fixes und Backports sowie eine Confluence-Seite zum Sicherheitsvorfall oder Release für Rollen, Entscheidungen, QA-Status und Kommunikationsbereitschaft. Nutze Slack für die operative Abstimmung und verlinke getroffene Entscheidungen zurück in die Dokumentation.

  • Weise gemeinsam mit den Engineering Leads jedem bestätigten Problem eine technisch verantwortliche Person und einen Fälligkeitstermin zu. Eskaliere blockierte Behebungen und verbleibende Risiken über die etablierten Entscheidungswege von Product, InfoSec und der Führungsebene.

  • Verbessere die Sicherheitsabdeckung für unterstützte Versionen und zugehörige Produkte, darunter das Security Plugin, Commercial-Komponenten, Services sowie relevante App- und Extension-Schnittstellen.

  • Leite die technische Aufarbeitung nach Sicherheitsvorfällen und Releases. Überführe Ursachen in konkrete Präventionsmaßnahmen mit klarer Verantwortung, Tests, Tools oder Designänderungen und verfolge, ob diese Änderungen Wiederholungen reduzieren.

  • Fördere und entwickle die beiden Engineers weiter, stelle die Abdeckung von Commerce Core und Services sicher und mache die Arbeit des Teams in der Produktplanung sichtbar.

jobs.title: GTM Enablement - Product
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re hiring our first Product Enablement specialist. You will join the Product & Technical Enablement team and help our go-to-market teams get ready for every product launch, across Agents, APIs, and Creative.

You will support our global go-to-market teams. Your mission: help sellers understand, demo, and sell each new launch with confidence, with preparation that starts well before launch day.

What sets this role apart: we’re looking for someone who knows our products well enough to demo them and sell them. You have used agents, APIs, or creative tools hands-on, and you can explain how they work and why they matter to customers. You blend that with sales, solutions engineering, or product marketing experience, so you can teach sellers how to use a product, how to demo it, and how to pitch it.

This role sits within GTM Enablement and reports to the Product & Technical Enablement Lead. You will work in close partnership with:

  • Product marketing and engineering teams (keeping content accurate as the platform ships)

  • GTM enablement (aligning on shared onboarding infrastructure)

You will support product enablement for our go-to-market teams across Agents, APIs, and Creative, with the most day-to-day focus on API and Creative launches. This is a full-stack role on a lean team: you’ll build content, deliver training, design practice environments, and flex across products as needed.

What you’ll do

  • Support new product launches: get an early heads-up from product marketing, research, and engineering, follow releases from alpha through GA, and have training ready before launch day, not the week of

  • Build launch workshops: go beyond what shipped and why it matters, with hands-on workshops on how to use the product, how to demo it, and how to pitch the value

  • Support competitive enablement: turn product marketing battlecards into trainings, simulations, and demo workshops, so sellers can answer parity, differentiation, and value questions with confidence

  • Support product certification: help define what “product certified” means for GTM teams, and build the playbooks and training content that raise product confidence across the whole field, not only new hires

  • Support everboarding and onboarding: keep training tied to new releases and capabilities, and keep content current as products ship

  • Craft realistic practice environments: demo certifications, role-play scenarios, and customer simulations with scored feedback, built on our own agent technology

  • Operate AI-natively: use ElevenLabs’ own voice and agent technology to build training and practice environments; default to AI tools to build faster, and teach others to do the same

  • Measure what matters: define and track the percent of sellers certified within 2 weeks of GA, demo and pitch quality scores, and win rate and stage progression against named competitors, and use the data to improve each launch

Requirements

We’re looking for someone who knows our products well and can teach sellers to demo and sell them. You’ll thrive here if you:

  • Have 4-7+ years as an enterprise seller or solutions engineer, or as a seller who moved into product marketing or enablement, at a SaaS, platform, or API-first company

  • Are hands-on with agents, APIs, or creative tools, and understand at a conceptual level how they work

  • Have demoed and pitched technical products to customers, and can explain the value, not only the features

  • Have a track record of teaching, mentoring, or building training, in addition to your customer-facing work

  • Are comfortable building a program from scratch, with no playbook to inherit

  • Have credibility with sellers, built from time in the seat or supporting sellers directly, and work well with product marketing, research, and engineering teams

  • Communicate clearly and can adapt product material for different audiences without diluting it

Bonus

  • Background in voice AI, conversational AI, or contact center technology

  • Vertical depth in financial services, healthcare, telecom or CCaaS, or at other AI companies

  • Hands-on experience with competing voice and agent platforms

  • Experience running workshops or labs for sellers or customers

  • Experience building role-play, simulation, or demo practice environments

Location

Remote-first, globally distributed role. Expect occasional travel to team hubs and onboarding sessions. Candidates should be able to work effectively across US and European time zones.

jobs.title: Interim Senior BI Analyst (All Genders)
jobs.description:
Across Europe, fleets are under enormous pressure. Fuel costs are rising. Regulatory requirements are tightening. The shift to low-emission vehicles is accelerating. And yet around 70% of European businesses still manage their fleets manually, with spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and processes that were never built for this moment. Shiftmove exists to make this simple.

We are a profitable B2B SaaS company and the fastest-growing fleet management platform in Europe, born from the merger of Avrios and Vimcar, and now serving tens of thousands of corporate customers across Germany, France, Spain, Switzerland, Poland, and beyond. Most recently, we acquired Optimum and Ocean in France, expanding our footprint and doubling down on one of Europe's largest fleet markets. Our AI-powered platform connects real-time vehicle data with intelligent software so that businesses can procure smarter, control costs, stay compliant, and lead the transition to cleaner mobility, all from one place.

About the role:

We are looking for an experienced Interim Senior BI Analyst to join us on an initial three-month contract, with the option to extend for a further three months.

As we integrate two acquired French businesses into our group, we need to bring their data into our standard reporting while transforming how our executive team accesses and uses business intelligence. Our existing Tableau dashboards have evolved over time, and we see an opportunity to make them clearer, more consistent and more actionable.

Reporting to our VP of Operations, Data & BI, you will work closely with the executive team, Head of FP&A, RevOps and Data Engineering. You will take ownership of rebuilding our executive reporting, responding to daily analytical requests and ensuring that acquired-company data is accurately reflected in group-wide reporting.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong technical BI skills with commercial acumen, sound analytical judgement and the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders when the data tells a different story.

What You'll Do

  • Rebuild executive reporting: Audit our existing Tableau dashboards and the underlying business logic. Decide which dashboards to retain, consolidate, redesign or retire, and rebuild the priority dashboards so executives can quickly understand performance and make informed decisions
  • Establish consistent metrics: Document and align metric definitions to ensure that business performance is measured consistently across dashboards, teams and entities
  • Own daily ad hoc reporting: Manage requests through our Jira-based data support queue, prioritising, scoping and delivering analyses on a daily basis. Translate ambiguous requests into clear business questions and identify recurring needs that can be addressed through standard reporting
  • Integrate acquisition data: Partner with Data Engineering as acquired-company data is migrated into Snowflake. Validate and reconcile data against source systems, build and maintain dbt models, and incorporate the data into existing Tableau dashboards so group reporting reflects all entities
  • Deliver commercial insights: Translate executive requirements into meaningful analysis of go-to-market performance, including pipeline, bookings, ARR, retention and churn
  • Partner with Finance: Work closely with the Head of FP&A to reconcile BI reporting with financial figures and establish a consistent view of business performance
  • Present findings and challenge assumptions: Communicate insights directly to the executive team, explain what the data means for the business, and challenge assumptions where the evidence supports a different conclusion
  • Enable a smooth handover: Document dashboards, data models, metric definitions and reporting processes so the permanent BI team can take ownership of the work at the end of the interim period

What You Need to Succeed

  • You bring extensive experience in BI or analytics, including at least three years working at a senior level
  • You have expert-level Tableau dashboard development skills, including experience redesigning dashboards for executive audiences
  • You have strong SQL skills and hands-on experience working with Snowflake
  • You have practical experience with dbt, including building and maintaining data models, tests and documentation
  • You understand go-to-market performance and are fluent in metrics such as pipeline, bookings, ARR, net and gross retention, and churn
  • You have a track record of translating executive requirements into analysis that informs business decisions
  • You have experience integrating acquired, migrated or otherwise disparate data sources into existing reporting environments
  • You are comfortable managing a Jira ticket queue and delivering reporting requests within daily turnaround expectations
  • You communicate exceptionally well in written and spoken English and are confident presenting to C-level stakeholders, including challenging assumptions when the data warrants it
  • You are based in Europe and available to work 35 hours per week for the duration of the contract

Nice to have:

  • French or German language skills
  • Experience in a SaaS or subscription-based business
  • Experience working with Salesforce, HubSpot or NetSuite data models
  • Experience building a semantic layer or self-service analytics capabilities for executive stakeholders
  • Experience reporting to private equity investors or preparing board-level reporting packs

What Success Looks Like

We want you to make a tangible impact from the start

  • By Day 30: Complete an audit of existing dashboards and underlying business logic, with a clear recommendation to retain, consolidate, redesign or retire each dashboard. Take ownership of the Jira queue and establish a reliable daily delivery rhythm
  • By Day 90: Have the priority executive dashboards rebuilt and in use, agree metric definitions with the Head of FP&A, and bring the first acquired-company data into standard group reporting
  • By Day 180 (if extended): Complete the rebuild of all in-scope dashboards, incorporate all migrated acquisition data into standard reporting, convert recurring ad hoc requests into standard reports, and complete the handover to the permanent BI team

Why Shiftmove

Why should you join us? At Shiftmove, you can contribute to an established, product-led company focused on delivering real value to its customers, with meaningful recurring revenue and an ambitious agenda for growth

  • Autonomy: We bring you in for your expertise and give you the ownership and space to deliver meaningful results.
  • Impact: Play a direct role in shaping executive reporting and integrating acquired businesses into a consistent, group-wide view of performance
  • Fair and equitable compensation: Interim compensation will be discussed based on your expertise, experience and geographic location
  • Dog-friendly office: Because furry coworkers make everything better! 🐶

SOUNDS LIKE YOU?

If you don't tick all the boxes but believe you can thrive in this role, we would love to hear from you.

Shiftmove is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse experiences and demographic characteristics that have nurtured unique viewpoints benefit our growth and performance. Just be yourself, and maybe you'll bring something valuable to the role we didn't initially think of.

If you need specific accommodations (tools, time, etc.) due to any special needs, and you are happy to disclose this, please let us know. We are happy to make adjustments, as support can make a decisive difference in the application process.

jobs.title: Flight Software Architect
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

The Flight Software Architect plays a key role in defining and maintaining the software architecture for our spacecraft flight software. The role ensures that the flight software architecture meets mission needs, system-level requirements, and safety and reliability objectives, while remaining scalable, maintainable, and suitable for the evolving needs of our spacecraft platforms. Working closely with Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and other functional disciplines, the Flight Software Architect drives architectural decisions, technical consistency, and the integration of software across the spacecraft.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as Flight Software Architect, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

What we would love to see from you

  1. Software architecture & design — Define, develop, and maintain the overall flight software architecture, including software components, interfaces, data flows, and execution models, ensuring alignment with spacecraft system architecture and mission objectives.

  2. Technical leadership & architectural decisions — Drive key architectural decisions and establish design principles, technical standards, and best practices for flight software development. Provide technical guidance to software engineers and ensure consistency across software components and development activities.

  3. System integration & interfaces — Define and coordinate software interfaces with avionics, onboard computers, sensors, actuators, GNC, communication systems, and other spacecraft subsystems. Ensure robust integration across functional disciplines and support the resolution of cross-system technical challenges.

  4. Requirements & traceability — Translate mission and system-level requirements into software architectural requirements, design constraints, and interface specifications. Ensure traceability between requirements, architecture, implementation, and verification, working closely with Systems Engineering and functional chain owners.

  5. Reliability, safety & performance — Ensure that architectural decisions address fault tolerance, robustness, timing constraints, resource utilization, failure detection and recovery, and overall spacecraft reliability. Contribute to safety analyses, failure management strategies, and the definition of appropriate software verification and validation approaches.

  6. Verification, validation & technical risk management — Identify and mitigate architectural risks, assess technical trade-offs, and support design reviews, integration campaigns, and verification activities. Ensure that the architecture is validated against mission requirements and that critical technical assumptions are verified early in the development lifecycle.

  7. Cross-functional collaboration & technical communication — Act as a technical reference for flight software architecture, facilitating alignment between Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and external partners, including ESA where applicable. Communicate architectural decisions, constraints, and trade-offs clearly to both technical teams and project stakeholders.

In the role of Flight Software Architect, ideally, you will have the following:

  • 10–15 years of professional experience in software engineering, including substantial experience in flight software, embedded software, or safety- and mission-critical systems.

  • Proven experience defining and evolving software architectures for complex critical software systems, ideally for spacecraft, launch vehicles, satellites, or other aerospace applications.

  • Strong knowledge of real-time embedded software, operating systems, hardware–software interfaces, resource-constrained computing, and distributed or fault-tolerant systems.

  • Experience translating system-level requirements into software architectures, interface specifications, and verification strategies.

  • A solid understanding of software integration, testing, verification and validation, and configuration and change management in a complex engineering environment.

  • Experience with architectural trade-off analysis, technical risk management, and making sound engineering decisions under performance, reliability, schedule, and resource constraints.

  • The ability to work effectively across multiple engineering disciplines and align stakeholders around clear technical solutions.

  • Strong structured thinking, analytical skills, and the ability to simplify complex technical challenges into robust and maintainable architectures.

  • Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions, document design rationale, and provide technical guidance to multidisciplinary teams.

  • A strong ownership mindset, a pragmatic approach to problem-solving, and a passion for developing reliable software that enables humanity’s exploration of space.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. jobs.title: Doctorant.e: Quantification des pesticides dans les dépôts atmosphériques : Origine et Variabilité  CDD 36 mois à IMT Nord Europe
jobs.description:
Unité : CERI EE (IMT NE) et Institut de Chimie et Procédés pour l'Energie l'Environnement et la Santé (ICPEES, UMR 7515 CNRS, Université de Strasbourg)

Responsable hiérarchique : Nadine Locoge (IMT NE)

Responsable fonctionnel : Dr. Aude Bourin (IMT NE), Prof. Alexandre Tomas (IMT NE), et Prof. Maurice Millet (Université de Strasbourg)

Catégorie :

Nature de l’emploi : Doctorat

Lieu de travail : Strasbourg / Douai

Contexte :

Le doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration scientifique entre le Centre d’Enseignement, Recherche et Innovation Energie Environnement (CERI EE) d’IMT Nord Europe et l’UMR 7515 CNRS-UNISTRA : ICPEES (Institut de Chimie et Procédés pour l’Energie, l’Environnement et la Santé) dont l’objectif est de renseigner l’influence des pluies sur les dépôts de pesticides au niveau national, en plus des données existantes dans l’air ambiant.

L’IMT Nord Europe est une école sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique. IMT Nord Europe est née en 2017 de la fusion de Télécom Lille et de l’École des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd’hui parmi les plus Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 élèves, dont un quart d’apprentis, plus de 600 diplômés par an et un réseau de 15 000 diplômés. Elle fait partie de l’Institut Mines Télécom, premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l’université de Lille.

IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.

Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20 000 m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les trois domaines « Systèmes Numériques », « Energie Environnement » et « Matériaux et Procédés ».

Le CERI EE d’IMT Nord Europe développe des activités au cœur des transitions énergétiques et environnementales. Sa recherche est orientée vers les sciences de l'atmosphère, la qualité des environnements intérieurs et les enjeux de l’efficacité énergétique et de la décarbonation. La candidate/le candidat intégrera l’un des 3 axes thématiques du CERI EE, l’axe OSPA (Observations, Sources et Processus physico-chimiques Atmosphériques).

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr et celui du CERI EE https://recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr/energie-environnement-ceri

L’ICPEES (Institut de Chimie et Procédés pour l'Energie, l'Environnement et la Santé, UMR 7515 du CNRS et de l’Université de Strasbourg) a été créé en janvier 2013 lorsque deux laboratoires, le Laboratoire des matériaux, surfaces et procédés pour la catalyse (LMSPC) et le Laboratoire d'ingénierie des polymères pour les hautes technologies (LIPHT), décident de fusionner. Lors de la fusion, les trois équipes du LIPHT et les sept équipes du LMSPC ont été structurées en trois départements de recherche : catalyse et matériaux, chimie moléculaire et analytique, ingénierie des polymères.

La transversalité des compétences présentes au sein de l’Institut permet de traiter des problématiques globales allant de la synthèse des molécules à l’élaboration de l’objet final pour des applications liées à l'Energie, l'Environnement ou la Santé. L’implication forte des équipes de l’unité dans les recherches fondamentales avec une visée applicative a permis au laboratoire de se positionner sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur et d’acquérir une renommée internationale. Les collaborations académiques tant nationales qu’internationales ont contribué aussi aux développements de nouveaux axes de recherche inexploités à l’heure actuelle. Les développements avals des recherches menées au sein de l’unité ont également permis de tisser de nombreuses collaborations avec le monde socio-économique en apportant des solutions concrètes aux différentes demandes sociétales et en développant de nouveaux procédés en adéquation avec les nouvelles législations. 

Les activités de recherche au sein de l’unité ne peuvent être menées d’une manière sereine, sans l’appui fort des pôles de soutien à la recherche, qui ont permis de fluidifier les demandes techniques et administratives. L’excellente cohésion entre ces pôles et les équipes de recherche a contribué également à mieux anticiper des problèmes éventuels et à d’optimiser le fonctionnement quotidien au sein de l’unité. En 2020, la direction de l’ICPEES a organisé le service commun technique en 3 pôles : le Pôle Caractérisation, le Pôle Ingénierie et Développement et le Pôle Chimie.

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’ICPEES :

https://icpees.unistra.fr

Missions :

Le doctorant aura pour mission d’évaluer la dynamique des dépôts atmosphériques de pesticides à différentes échelles spatiales et temporelles en collaboration avec l’observatoire MERA (https://www.lcsqa.org/fr/le-dispositif-mera) et les AASQA (https://www.atmo-france.org/) sur le territoire national. Dans un premier temps, il devra adapter les méthodes d’analyse de pesticides existantes en GC/MSMS et LC/MSMS dans l’équipe « CAMATES (Chimie Analytique MATériaux, Environnement Santé) » de l’ICPEES (UMR 7515 CNRS-UNISTRA), en particulier intégrer les pesticides de la liste prioritaire de l’ANSES[1] et ceux du dispositif Pesticides coordonné par le LCSQA[2] (https://www.lcsqa.org/fr/le-dispositif-pesticides). Il aura également pour mission de déterminer la méthode technique d’extraction de ces molécules et de quantifier l’effet de matrice/interférences potentiels que peuvent générer les eaux pluviales et les dépôts secs. Pour cela, il disposera d’échantillons réels de dépôts totaux (humides et secs) qu’il dopera avec des molécules non présentes dans les échantillons et des étalons marqués.

Il aura ensuite la tâche d’analyser les échantillons de dépôts atmosphériques collectés de manière hebdomadaire pendant 1 an sur plusieurs sites d’étude et également de quantifier si la réfrigération des échantillons pendant leur stockage dans le préleveur est indispensable.

Enfin, il aura à interpréter et analyser les résultats en termes d’occurrence, de variabilité spatiale et temporelle (influence de l’activité agricole), de relation avec les conditions météorologiques (trajectoire des masses d’air) et de corrélation avec d’autres polluants atmosphériques ou des mesures de pesticides dans l’air ambiant réalisées en parallèle par les AASQA.

 

Activités :

  1.       Instrumentation pour les dépôts atmosphériques et développements analytiques (t0 – t6) -- à Douai puis Strasbourg

  •            effectuer des essais techniques pour vérifier la conformité des appareils de collecte des dépôts atmosphériques (Douai)

  •            modification de méthodes existantes en GC/MSMS et LC/MSMS (retraits/ajouts de molécules),

  •            développement MSMS des nouvelles molécules,

  •            validation de la méthode (limites de détection et de quantification, répétabilité, reproductibilité,…)

  •            choix de la méthode de préparation des échantillons (LLE, SPE, SPME, …),

  •            évaluation des interférences et de l’effet de matrice par dopage avec des étalons deutérés et des molécules de pesticides non présentes dans les échantillons (screening de la présence/absence en amont)

2.       Analyse des échantillons collectés sur le terrain (t7 – t20) – à Strasbourg

  •            gestion hebdomadaire des échantillons : réception, extraction, analyses, conditionnement des flacons

  •            traitement des résultats obtenus d’analyses : prétraitement des données, intégration des chromatogrammes, identification des composés, quantification et validation des résultats avec contrôle qualité

3.       Interprétation des résultats acquis (t21 – t28) -- à Douai

4.       Rédaction de publications, du mémoire de thèse et valorisations à l’international (t21 – t36) – à Douai

 

Participations éventuelles aux activités d’enseignement en chimie analytique (TP en Licence pour l’Université de Strasbourg) (dans la limite de 64 heures par année scolaire).


[1] Agence Nationale de Sécurité Sanitaire de l’alimentation, de l’environnement et du travail

[2] Laboratoire Central de Surveillance de la Qualité de l’Air


Profil du candidat : (Prérequis/ Diplôme)

Un(e) candidat(e) titulaire d’un master en chimie analytique, avec des connaissances spécifiques en techniques expérimentales (LC-MS/MS, GC-MS/MS).

 

Savoir-être

Savoir-faire

Connaissances

Rigueur scientifique

Esprit d’équipe

Savoir communiquer sur ses activités en français et en anglais

Participer à la vie du laboratoire (aider/encadrer des stagiaires)

Participer à la maintenance des équipements analytiques

Développement de méthode d’analyse en chromatographie couplée à la spectrométrie de masse

Optimisation des paramètres de quantification de polluants en trace dans des matrices complexes

Chromatographie

Spectrométrie de masse

Préparation d’échantillons

Echantillonnage dans l’air

Traitement de données statistiques

 

 

 

Conditions :

Le poste est à pourvoir à compter de février 2027 pour une durée de 36 mois.

 

Renseignements et modalités de dépôt de candidature :

 

  •          Pour tout renseignement sur le poste, merci de vous adresser à :

MILLET Maurice ; Professeur ; ICPEES (UMR 7515 CNRS - UNISTRA) – 25 rue Becquerel – 67087 Strasbourg Cedex 3 ; tél : 03 68 85 28 66 ; E-mail : BOURIN Aude ; Ingénieure de recherche ; IMT Nord Europe (CERI « Energie et Environnement ») ; tél : 03 27 71 26 18 ; E-mail :          Pour tout renseignement administratif, merci de vous adresser à la Direction des Ressources Humaines :          Par ailleurs, le poste peut être aménagé pour une personne en situation de handicap.

jobs.title: Product Builder - Mo (AI health companion)
jobs.description:
🤖 Who we are

We’re building Mo — a health companion for everyone.

We’re a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. We are building Mo, an intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise - through chat, voice, or video. That’s what we are building 🤖.

We kicked off the project in 2023, and we have launched Mo to all our french members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.

 

🚀 Why we need you

Mo’s scope is expanding fast: inside Alan (a new Clinic, new capabilities), across the countries we operate in, and at the interfaces with many other Alan experiences. To get this expansion right, and to keep ownership distributed within the team, we’re looking for a Product Builder to take on a real share of that complexity and ambiguity.

You’ll own end-to-end one slice of Mo’s product scope. Depending on your profile, it could be:

  • 🩺 Mo for reactive care. Build all the integrations between Mo, our Clinic and the healthcare system, and shape how our medical team interacts with members in and through Mo.

  • 🛡️ Mo for insurance. Make Mo the main interface between members and Alan, building on our Support AI agents, across channels and countries.

  • 🌍 Mo global. Adapt Mo to new countries and find the right operating model for each (medical reviews, safety, local features).

  • ➕ Mo as a platform. Make Mo the companion other teams build upon, so our domain experts can ship their own experiences through it.

🎯 Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for Product Builders with around 5+ years of experience who want to build state-of-the-art AI products and apply them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

  • You’ll own a product area end-to-end: problem framing, vision, prioritisation, shipping, and measuring whether we actually help members get and stay better.

  • You’ll work daily with engineers, ML engineers, data, and doctors, at the frontier of LLMs and agentic systems, and see your work in production with real people.

  • You’ll navigate ambiguity and many stakeholders across Alan, and turn it into clear decisions and a focused roadmap.

  • You’ll be hands-on: prototyping, digging into data, reading conversations and evals, getting into the technical details with the team.

  • You’ll contribute to our product culture and help build the team (hiring, interview loops, etc.).

You would be a good fit in Mo if most of this sounds like you:

  • Experience building and shipping a live AI/LLM product

  • Very hands-on, comfortable with technical and data topics (SQL, prototyping, understanding how an LLM system behaves and fails)

  • Interest or experience in one or several medical or prevention themes

  • Product-minded and outcome-driven: you care about impact, not output

  • Self-directed, pragmatic, driven, hard working

  • Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!)

  • Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching

  • Fluent in English

  • Ex-engineers and ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus

 

🤘 How we do it ?

We benefit from Alan’s platform, infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise — but operate with the speed and focus of a startup. If you’re curious about Alan’s broader vision, our Shareholder Letters are worth a read.

People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

 

How we work: our Leadership Principles

  • Mission is the Boss — We think long-term and are methodical optimists who take risks, seeking our mission's success above all else.

  • Distributed Ownership — Accountable enlightened despots: everyone owns their decisions and results.

  • Radical Transparency — All information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously.

  • Always Growing — Direct, positive, and caring feedback, combined with self-growth ownership.

 

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

 

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.
