jobs.description:
Lieu :    Lyon                                                                           Date souhaitée de démarrage :  11/01/2027

Durée :  6 mois                                                             

« S’engager aux côtés d’HI, c’est agir pour venir en aide aux populations vulnérables que nous soutenons sur le terrain. Pour mener à bien cette mission, nous recherchons des étudiants motivés et prêts à mettre leur énergie au service d’une cause qui a du sens »

HI, Humanité & Inclusion est une organisation de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et des populations vulnérables, elle agit et témoigne, pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels, pour améliorer leurs conditions de vie et promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux.

Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap.  

Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux 1ers entretiens. 

 

Pour plus d’information sur l’association : www.hi.org

 

OBJECTIFS DU STAGE :

Le stage se fera au sein du service Sensibilisation - Communication de Handicap International, au siège de Lyon, dans le cadre des missions quotidiennes du service avec un large volet dédié à l’organisation des déploiements des Pyramides de chaussures. Être un soutien au service Sensibilisation - Communication dans leurs actions de sensibilisation et tout projet. 

Nous vous invitons à prendre connaissance des actions de sensibilisation et mobilisation en consultant : l’Espace du bénévolat et de la sensibilisation pour Handicap International.

La mission se déroulera du 11 janvier au 10 juillet 2027 (6 mois).

Les Pyramides de chaussures c’est le temps fort de sensibilisation et de mobilisation citoyenne pour Handicap International. Depuis plus de 30 ans, tous les citoyens, scolaires, salariés d’entreprises, sympathisants de Handicap International ou encore politiques sont invités à venir :

-          Lancer leurs chaussures pour témoigner de leur soutien aux causes portées par Handicap International, la chaussure symbole de l’engagement citoyen pour protéger les civils ;

-          S’informer à travers une exposition interactive, ludique et pédagogique sur Handicap International, ses champs d’intervention et ses combats ;

-          Rencontrer et échanger avec nos experts terrain

Depuis 2024 Handicap International a développé des Pyramides de chaussures dites « mobiles ». Le but ? Être présent toute l’année partout en France. Grâce à ce dispositif nous pouvons aller au plus proche de nos différentes cibles (scolaire, sympathisants, grand public, élus, médias) et leur proposer un temps de sensibilisation complet sur nos missions dans le monde. Pour en savoir plus sur les Pyramides : https://www.handicap-international.fr/fr/pyramides-de-chaussures

Le stage sera orienté autour de trois volets 

-          Appui à la prospection (recherche de structures hôtes ou de partenaires intéressés par des visites guidées)

-          Appui événementiel et logistique pour la préparation et le déroulement des déploiements.

-          Animation auprès du public (visites guidées, actions de sensibilisation, échanges lors d’évènements).

Le stage implique des déplacements réguliers (environ deux par mois) dans le cadre des animations et évènements extérieurs. Ces missions sont l’occasion de belles rencontres et d’échanges enrichissants avec des publics variés.

Le stage combine la prospection de nouveaux lieux de déploiement, l'appui à la coordination événementielle et logistique et l'animation auprès de publics variés. Une bonne connaissance des actions, des valeurs et des prises de position de Handicap International est nécessaire pour adapter les messages de sensibilisation au contexte géopolitique.

Activité 1 : Participer à la préparation et au déploiement des Pyramides de chaussures 2027

-          Prospection : identifier et contacter des villes, structures et partenaires susceptibles d'accueillir une Pyramide ; contribuer au suivi des contacts et des opportunités.

-          Coordination logistique : participer aux rétroplannings, à la préparation du matériel, à la mobilisation des bénévoles et à l'organisation opérationnelle des déploiements.

-          Relations avec les partenaires et prestataires : recherche de contacts, coordination, suivi des engagements, communication et fidélisation.

-          Participation aux événements en France : appui à la coordination sur place, installation et démontage, animation de visites guidées, prises de parole et échanges avec les publics.

-          Bilans et capitalisation : recueillir les retours d'expérience, contribuer aux bilans et à l'amélioration des outils et procédures.

Activité 2 : Soutenir l'organisation d'événements portés par d'autres services

-          Appuyer, selon les besoins, la logistique, la communication ou la prospection pour des événements transversaux (par exemple : vœux, inauguration des nouveaux locaux, Congrès des Notaires ou autres temps forts de l'association).

Activité 3 : Participer à la vie quotidienne du service sensibilisation – communication

-          Contribuer à la gestion de boîtes mail et au suivi des sollicitations, au suivi d'actions solidaires et à la préparation de nouvelles actions ou événements de mobilisation

-          Contribuer à l'animation et au déploiement du défi de Damien Seguin pour l'inclusion et la solidarité internationale, avec un focus sur le volet scolaire : mobilisation et accompagnement des établissements scolaires, diffusion des outils pédagogiques, appui à l'organisation d'actions de sensibilisation et de défis solidaires, suivi des établissements participants et valorisation de leurs initiatives.

Requirements

Niveau Master

Intérêt marqué pour la solidarité internationale et volonté de connaître les actions et valeurs de Handicap International.

Gestion de projet événementiel

Intérêt pour la prospection et la prise de contact avec des partenaires et collectivités.

Aisance relationnelle (interventions orales et tel)

Une expérience associative ou bénévole serait un plus.

Bonne expression écrite et orale.

Goût pour le travail en équipe.

Organisation, rigueur, sens des priorités et capacité d'adaptation.

Bon sens, autonomie et prise d'initiative.

Benefits

CONDITIONS DU STAGE:

Vous recevrez :

·     Une gratification mensuelle de 693€ pour un stage temps plein, 6 mois (stage à partir du 11 janvier 2026)

·     Des tickets restaurant d’une valeur faciale de 8,96 euros (60 % à la charge de l’employeur, 40% à votre charge)

·     Une participation de 50% à votre abonnement au titre des transports

·     De nombreuses activités sportives et sociales sont proposées dans nos locaux 

 

Vous devez disposer d’une convention de stage obligatoire délivrée par un établissement d’enseignement ou de formation français.

jobs.description:
📍 Localisation : Nantes (Ile de Nantes)
📅 Début : ASAP
⏳ Durée : 6 mois
💰 Gratification de stage : conformément au minimum conventionnel en vigueur.

Lengow, expert des solutions e-commerce intelligentes 

Lengow est un acteur de référence des solutions e-commerce intelligentes, qui accompagne les marques et les distributeurs dans leur croissance rentable sur les canaux digitaux.

Grâce à ses solutions performantes de gestion de flux produits, de veille tarifaire internationale et d'analyse de données, Lengow propose une suite complète d'outils SaaS permettant aux e-commerçants d'améliorer la visibilité de leurs produits en ligne, de renforcer leur compétitivité grâce à des stratégies de prix éclairées, de développer leurs ventes sur les marketplaces et de suivre la présence de leur marque auprès des distributeurs.

Depuis 2009, Lengow accompagne la croissance digitale de plus de 3 600 clients, sur des milliers de canaux marketing et de vente, dans plus de 60 pays.

Votre rôle au sein de la Legal Team

Dans le cadre de nos activités, nous recherchons un.e stagiaire Juriste en Droit du Numérique & Protection des Données Personnelles pour rejoindre notre Legal Team.

Directement rattaché.e à la Head of Legal, vous participerez activement aux projets juridiques de l'entreprise, avec une attention particulière portée à la conformité RGPD, aux évolutions réglementaires du secteur numérique et aux enjeux liés à l'intelligence artificielle.

Vous aurez également l'opportunité de collaborer avec différentes équipes internes (Product, Tech, Sales, Marketing, HR, etc.) et de développer une approche pratique et opérationnelle du droit.

Vos missions

1. Protection des données personnelles & conformité RGPD

  • Participer au suivi et à l'amélioration de la conformité de Lengow en matière de protection des données personnelles.
  • Contribuer à la mise à jour du registre des activités de traitement des données personnelles, en collaboration avec les différentes équipes internes.
  • Participer à la revue et à la mise à jour de la documentation relative à la protection des données (politiques de confidentialité, DPA, procédures internes, etc.).
  • Accompagner la Legal Team dans l'analyse de questions relatives au RGPD et à la protection des données dans le cadre des projets de l'entreprise.
  • Contribuer à la sensibilisation des équipes internes aux enjeux de protection des données, notamment à travers la préparation et l'animation de courtes formations sur les notions fondamentales du RGPD et les bonnes pratiques à adopter au quotidien.

2. Droit du numérique & Intelligence Artificielle

  • Participer à l'analyse des enjeux juridiques liés aux nouvelles technologies, aux solutions SaaS et à l'intelligence artificielle.
  • Contribuer au suivi des évolutions réglementaires européennes, notamment du Règlement européen sur l'intelligence artificielle (AI Act), et à l'évaluation de leurs impacts potentiels sur les activités de Lengow.
  • Participer aux réflexions et projets internes relatifs à l'utilisation de l'intelligence artificielle et à la mise en place de bonnes pratiques.

3. Contrats commerciaux & accompagnement des équipes

  • Participer à la rédaction et à la revue de contrats commerciaux en français et en anglais (contrats SaaS, accords de confidentialité, contrats fournisseurs, accords de partenariat, etc.).
  • Contribuer à l'analyse des clauses contractuelles, notamment celles relatives à la protection des données, à la confidentialité et à la responsabilité.
  • Accompagner la Head of Legal dans le traitement des demandes juridiques des équipes opérationnelles.
  • Participer à la mise à jour des modèles contractuels et des documents juridiques internes.

4. Veille juridique & projets transverses

  • Assurer une veille juridique et réglementaire sur les évolutions en matière de protection des données personnelles, de droit du numérique et d'intelligence artificielle.
  • Réaliser des recherches juridiques et rédiger des synthèses claires et accessibles pour les équipes internes.
  • Contribuer à des projets transverses visant à améliorer les processus, les outils et la documentation juridique de Lengow.

Requirements

Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Vous préparez un Master 2 en droit du numérique ou, droit des nouvelles technologies, droit des données personnelles ou droit des affaires, avec un intérêt marqué pour les enjeux numériques ou vous êtes en école d'avocats.
  • Vous disposez de bonnes connaissances du RGPD et des principes fondamentaux de la protection des données personnelles.
  • Vous portez un intérêt particulier aux évolutions réglementaires liées à l'intelligence artificielle, notamment à l'AI Act.
  • Vous possédez de bonnes bases en droit des contrats.
  • Vous avez un bon niveau d'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
  • Vous êtes rigoureux.se, curieux.se, autonome et proactif.ve, avec de bonnes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse.Vous faites preuve de pédagogie pour rendre les sujets juridiques accessibles à des interlocuteurs non juristes et appréciez le travail en équipe.

Notre processus de recrutement

  1. Un premier échange téléphonique avec notre Head of Legal pour faire connaissance et échanger sur votre parcours et vos motivations.
  2. Un entretien pour approfondir les échanges, vous présenter les missions et mieux comprendre vos attentes.
  3. Bienvenue chez Lengow ! Si nos attentes sont alignées, nous passons à la signature de votre convention de stage.

Benefits

Avantages  

🏡 Horaires flexibles, 2 jours de télétravail par semaine 

🍴 Tickets restaurant (EdenRed) : 8 €/jour, pris en charge à 50 % par Lengow

🚲 Indemnité mobilité douce jusqu’à 200 €/an ou remboursement des transports en commun à 50 %

🍎 Fruits frais livrés au bureau chaque semaine

🎉 Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour se retrouver et partager des moments ensemble

  • Strong analytical skills and a precise, structured approach to complex data and processes

  • A proactive, hands-on working style with a high degree of personal responsibility

  • Previous leadership or people management experience is an advantage

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across different functions and organisations

  • High level of integrity, reliability and accountability

  • Comfortable working in an international, regulated financial services environment

  • University or FH degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting or a comparable discipline

  • Excellent English skills; German and French are advantageous

What We Offer:

  • A senior position with broad responsibility for the operational management of a Swiss and Luxembourg fund portfolio

  • The opportunity to shape and further improve the Fund Operations function and its processes

  • A varied role combining leadership, fund operations, data and automation

  • Regular interaction with senior internal stakeholders and key external partners

  • The opportunity to contribute to the Valuation Committee and support important fund-related decisions

  • Significant scope to introduce process improvements and strengthen automation and data quality

  • Flexible working arrangements and a modern working environment

  • Opportunities for continued professional and personal development

Our mission for you

European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk - and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, Flex - combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings - all while helping companies switch to renewable energy.

We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast - the market window is open and we intend to own it.

About trawa

trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.

We're looking for a (Senior) Associate – Energy Markets & Business Development (Railway Power & PPAs) to own an important part of our energy value chain. You'll report directly to our Energy Operations Manager with close collaboration with the COO and Trading Team. You'll shape the product that makes European industry competitive again - and you'll do it at pace. This role is based in Berlin. trawa is an "office first" company, which means you will work from the office typically five days per week.

The Team

You'll join our Energy Operations team, which owns the energy side of our business - from sourcing and portfolio management to making sure our customers' energy products work in practice. You'll work hand in hand with our Trading Team as well as with Sales, Pricing, Product and Tech. You start without direct reports, but with a clear mandate: build and grow the business areas you own.

What you'll do

As (Senior) Associate – Energy Markets & Business Development, you combine a strong analytical mind with business building:

Build our railway power business: A significant share of our customers comes from the railway power (Bahnstrom) segment. You take ownership of this segment from a trading and energy perspective - you understand its specific market setup, improve how we forecast, source, price and supply railway power, and make us the go-to partner for these customers. You dig into how we currently predict our railway customers' energy demand and find ways to make these forecasts more accurate. You also build partnerships with IT service providers from the railway industry and with infrastructure operators.

Lead international railway expansion: You drive the expansion of our railway power offering into further European countries - you analyse market structures, regulation and commercial potential, and contribute your findings into a concrete go-to-market plan.

Expand our long-term product offering: Our customers buy long-term products from us, such as PPAs and Future/Forwards products. You develop our offering so we can provide more and better-fitting products to our customers.

Architect of the long-term trading process: You centralise and streamline the end-to-end process from pricing and offer creation to actual trade execution across Sales, Pricing, Trading and Operations - making it faster, more robust and scalable, and ultimately enabling a better product for our customers.

Bridge between trading and business: You work closely with our quant trading and data science team and turn their models and insights into processes and systems that work across teams and markets - so that pricing, risk and market insights reliably translate into better decisions and products for our customers.

Who we are looking for

Strong quantitative skills: You think analytically, feel at home with numbers and data and can confidently challenge quantitative results - without having to be a quant or developer yourself. Ideally, you have a degree in a quantitative or business field (e.g. economics, engineering, industrial engineering, business administration).

Business acumen & venture mindset: You think commercially, enjoy building new business areas from scratch and prioritise by impact.

Interest in energy markets & trading: You are fascinated by how energy markets work - from wholesale and forward markets to PPAs, hedging and pricing - and want to dive deep into them. First exposure to these topics is a strong plus.

Hungry & ambitious: You want to grow fast, take on responsibility early and set high standards for yourself. You don't wait for instructions - you find answers, push topics forward and enjoy a steep learning curve.

High ownership & structured execution: You drive topics end-to-end, align stakeholders across departments and turn ideas into scalable processes with tangible business impact.

Communication: You speak German at native level and very good English, and you translate confidently between commercial, quantitative and operational perspectives.

90 Day Goals

After 6 Weeks (Onboarding):

  • You have understood trawa's business, product and energy value chain in detail and got to know all relevant internal and external stakeholders.

  • You understand our railway power customers, their contracts, how we currently forecast their energy demand and how we source, price and supply their energy.

  • You have mapped our current long-term trading process - from pricing and offer creation to trade execution - and identified the key pain points.

Month 3 (Ramp-Up):

  • You are the go-to person for trading and energy questions in the railway power segment, have implemented first improvements and developed a concept for improving our demand forecasts for railway customers.

  • You have delivered a first assessment of potential expansion markets for railway power, including a recommendation on which country to tackle first, and have identified and approached first potential partners among railway IT service providers and infrastructure operators.

  • You have designed a target process for our long-term trading, started its implementation and proposed first additions to our long-term product offering.

What Will Help You Succeed

  • Work experience in a high-paced environment, e.g. a start-up, scale-up or consulting.

  • Experience in energy markets - especially in energy trading, origination or pricing - or in financial trading markets.

  • Knowledge of the German energy market and/or the railway power (16.7 Hz traction power) market.

  • An affinity for AI-powered tools and automation to make processes faster and smarter.

Why us?

Impact: European SMEs spend between €150k and €10M per year on electricity — most are overpaying and locked into outdated procurement. Your product will directly change how thousands of companies buy, manage, and use energy. The impact is measurable, the market is massive, and the timing is now.

The Role: You build business areas at the intersection of trading, energy and venture development - with direct impact on our revenue, our product offering and our expansion across Europe.

Responsibility & Support: You own real business areas from day one - backed by our Energy Operations Manager, the COO and an experienced Trading Team who help you ramp up quickly and grow into the role.

Ownership: We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

Learning & Growth: We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You'll have opportunities for mentorship, learning, and career progression.

Diversity and Inclusion: We're an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences, and perspectives. At trawa, we're family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We're committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Package & Benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

jobs.description:
Join Neudata - Sales Director (EMEA & Asia-Pacific)

Introducing Neudata:

Neudata is the global leader in alternative and market data intelligence, helping investors, hedge funds and corporates discover, evaluate, and use data to make smarter decisions. Our independence is what really sets us apart - we provide objective, unbiased intelligence that our clients trust and depend on.

With offices in London, New York, and Shanghai and a team of 100 people, we connect a vast global network of buyers and providers through our market-leading platforms and specialist consulting - and by providing a clear view of the data landscape, we help organisations navigate complexity and find their competitive edge. Joining Neudata really puts you at the heart of the fintech industry, where your work directly influences the data-driven strategies of the world's most sophisticated organisations.

The Role:

We're looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial Sales Director to take our Scout and Ranger platforms to data buyers across EMEA and APAC: hedge funds, asset managers, private equity firms and the fast-growing world of AI. This is a pure new business role, and you'll own your territory end to end, from spotting the opportunity through to signing the deal.

Partnering directly with our Chief Revenue Officer, you'll play an important part in refining how we approach the EMEA and APAC data buyer markets, identifying opportunities for growth, developing repeatable sales practices, and laying the foundations for an expanded European sales team.

You'll be the face of Neudata in front of some of the most sophisticated investors in the market, running story-led demonstrations, guiding hands-on trials alongside our research analysts, and building relationships with the people who decide how their firms use external data.

We encourage applications from high-performing Sales Reps looking to take on greater ownership and responsibility in a fast-growing organisation. There is potential for the successful candidate to take on a leadership role over time.


Your Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the EMEA and Asia-Pacific territory of institutional investor prospects, driving new business through proactive outreach, travelling to meet prospects in-person, and lead generation campaigns across email and socials

  • Run the full sales cycle: leading discovery and qualification calls, delivering value-based, story-led demonstrations of Scout and Ranger, then negotiating commercial terms and closing in line with quota

  • Manage hands-on platform trials in partnership with our research analysts, aligning technical and business criteria so prospects can see the value for themselves

  • Represent Neudata on stage and on the ground, presenting at our own high-profile events and at external conferences in the UK and overseas

  • Become a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, from Heads of Data and Portfolio Managers through to Procurement Leads

  • Work closely with the CRO to develop and execute territory plans, prioritise attractive markets and client segments, and identify opportunities to accelerate growth

  • Keep your pipeline sharp with rigorous CRM discipline and accurate forecasting, and feed market insight back to our product and research teams to help shape where we go next

  • Contribute to the development of repeatable sales processes, messaging and best practices that can support an expanded European sales team

  • As the team expands, contribute to the recruitment, onboarding, coaching and development of new sales colleagues, with scope to take on formal management responsibilities

What You'll Bring:

  • Strong experience in data, research or information sales, ideally into financial services, with a proven track record of originating and closing complex new logo deals

  • Sharp commercial acumen and the confidence to negotiate and close

  • Experience independently developing new territories, market segments and commercial opportunities

  • Outstanding presentation and communication skills, in person and online, in front of senior and technical audiences alike

  • Familiarity with how investment firms buy, particularly asset managers and hedge funds, and with the stakeholders involved along the way

  • Genuine enthusiasm for alternative data, market data and investment research, and curiosity about where the data landscape is heading

  • Experience coaching or managing people in a commercial setting is a bonus, but not essential

Our Benefits & Perks:

  • 25 days' annual leave + bank holidays, plus an extra day for each year of service (up to 30 days), alongside one paid volunteering day and two paid study days per year 📅

  • Hybrid and flexible working, including working from anywhere for up to 10 working days per year from a location of your choosing 🌍

  • Private medical insurance via Vitality (including dental, optical, and hearing) ✚

  • Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental policies 🏠

  • Enhanced pension scheme via NEST 📈

  • Employee referral bonus of £1,000 per successful new hire you refer 💸

Key Details:

  • Location: London (Moorgate) with hybrid working. Frequent travel across EMEA and Asia is anticipated.

  • Salary: Competitive base salary and commission structure

  • Start Date: ASAP

  • Line Manager: Chief Revenue Officer

Recruitment Process:

  1. Initial screening call with our Talent Acquisition Manager

  2. First-stage competency interview

  3. Meetings with key Neudata stakeholders

  4. Final stage interview

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and shortlisted candidates will be invited to an initial screening call with our Talent Acquisition Manager.

Applicants must be eligible to work in the UK. Candidates who may require visa sponsorship should discuss this with the hiring manager during the interview process. Further information on Skilled Worker sponsorship can be found here.

jobs.title: Corporate Account Executive - Public Sector
Manager, Engineering, Secure Build and SCS Services (East Coast Preferred)
jobs.description:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

Secure Build builds and operates the infrastructure behind Docker's container builds. The team owns Docker Build Cloud and Docker Hub Automated Builds while developing the next generation of trusted build and CI capabilities. Its direction is to make Docker the trusted place CI runs: isolated execution, brokered access to secrets and networks, and verifiable evidence of what each build or test job did. The work spans Go services, container and build technology, cloud infrastructure, sandboxing and software supply-chain security, alongside the operational responsibility for production systems customers already depend on.

SCS Services builds the backend systems and product capabilities that help developers understand, secure and ship software with confidence. The team powers important parts of Docker Scout and Docker Hardened Images, including the services and workflows that turn supply-chain data into useful developer, customer and agent experiences. Its estate is deliberately polyglot, with Clojure and Go services, event-driven workflows, Kafka, legacy Datomic components and newer Spanner-backed services. It also supports the customer journey around discovering, assessing, subscribing to and managing hardened artefacts.

We are looking for one Engineering Manager to lead both teams. Together they sit at the centre of Docker's secure software supply-chain work: one creates trusted build outcomes, while the other turns build, artifact and dependency data into services and experiences used across Scout and Docker Hardened Images. This is a two-team leadership role with separate roadmaps, production responsibilities and technical domains. The teams should deliver independently, with explicit contracts and joined-up ownership where their services connect.

You will own the health, delivery and growth of both teams and make the trade-offs that keep them effective as a portfolio. You will not be expected to be the deepest expert in every language or domain. You will need enough technical breadth and current engineering judgement to engage credibly in designs, reviews and incidents across both teams, set direction with strong senior engineers, and recognise when the right answer is to create space for their expertise.

The kind of person we're looking for

The successful candidate leads first. They are an experienced engineering manager who can inherit two capable teams, earn trust quickly and help each become a high-performing, value-delivering part of the wider Docker organisation. They are deliberate about where they spend their attention, protect both teams from becoming the second priority, and make portfolio trade-offs visible rather than allowing urgency, proximity or the loudest stakeholder to decide.

They stay close to the technical work without trying to own every technical decision. They can hold a substantive conversation about distributed backend systems, event and data pipelines, build and CI infrastructure, trust boundaries and production operations. They are active in design and review, useful during incidents and willing to get hands-on where that moves the work forward. The balance still tilts strongly to leadership, coaching, delivery and organisational judgement.

They care about security as a product and engineering property, not only as compliance. They understand how modern attacks exploit identity, secrets, dependencies and build systems, and they can reason about the evidence customers need to trust an artefact or workflow. They lead through judgement, clarity and unblocking rather than ceremony for its own sake. Above all, they grow the engineers around them and help both teams ship outcomes developers and enterprises can rely on.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead Secure Build and SCS Services, owning delivery, team health, growth, performance and operational excellence across both.

  • Turn two changing roadmaps into a coherent portfolio plan with explicit priorities, capacity and trade-offs, and create leadership coverage so neither team becomes the permanent second priority.

  • Partner with Product to shape strategy and roadmaps for secure build, Docker Scout, Docker Hardened Images and the services that connect them.

  • Stay close to the technical work through design and code review, incident response and selective hands-on contribution where it adds leverage.

  • Ensure each team's technical direction supports product, security, reliability and customer priorities, setting it collaboratively with Staff and senior engineers while leaving clear decision ownership with them.

  • Own the interfaces between the teams, including trust boundaries, contracts, data quality, versioning, operational ownership and customer-facing failure modes.

  • Balance new product work with inherited systems and on-call, and invest in reliability improvements driven by recurring operational pain.

  • Own engineer growth and performance, handle difficult conversations directly, hire and retain strong people and build succession depth within both teams.

  • Align Product, Design, Security, DHI Content, Registry, Hub, sales, support, commercial and legal partners while shielding the teams from churn.

  • Lead disciplined use of AI-assisted engineering and communicate decisions, risks and progress clearly across UK and US working hours.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 5+ years managing high-performing engineering teams, with meaningful responsibility across more than one team or distinct technical domain.

  • 8+ years of professional, hands-on software engineering experience in backend, infrastructure, platform or developer tooling.

  • Experience leading, growing and retaining engineers at or above your own technical seniority, including teams you did not build and difficult performance conversations.

  • A leader-first operating model, with current enough technical judgement to participate in design and review across unfamiliar systems without needing to be the best engineer in the room.

  • Experience prioritising across competing roadmaps, operational load and stakeholder commitments, with clear mechanisms for allocating attention and capacity.

  • Strong backend and distributed-systems judgement, including APIs, event-driven architectures, data stores, cloud-native infrastructure and production operations.

  • Understanding of CI or build-system internals, containers and artefact workflows, plus a strong interest in software supply-chain security and trust boundaries.

  • Experience leading teams that operate production infrastructure through on-call, incident response, observability, SLOs and the work required to reduce recurring operational load.

  • Strong product judgement and evidence of shaping roadmaps with Product rather than only receiving requirements.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, strong cross-functional influence, customer closeness and comfort leading a remote-first organisation across European and US time zones.

Helpful, but Not Required

  • Experience with Go, Clojure or both, and evidence of becoming effective across a polyglot estate.

  • Experience with Kafka, Spanner, Datomic or comparable event-streaming and distributed-data systems.

  • Experience with OCI, BuildKit, Buildx, GitHub Actions or comparable build and CI platforms.

  • Experience with sandboxing, microVMs, untrusted workload execution or multi-tenant infrastructure.

  • Experience with SLSA, in-toto, SBOMs, VEX, Sigstore, cosign, provenance, signing or vulnerability scanning.

  • Experience evolving legacy systems while shipping new capability for developer tools, security products, regulated customers or software-agent workflows.

What to expect

First 30 days

  • Build relationships with every engineer and the Product partners for both teams before changing structure, process or roadmap.

  • Understand Secure Build's product direction, production estate and on-call load, including Docker Build Cloud and Docker Hub Automated Builds.

  • Understand the SCS Services products, customers, architecture and operational profile, and map the dependencies, trust boundaries and ownership lines between the teams.

First 90 days.

  • Own a coherent portfolio plan with both teams and Product, including explicit capacity for roadmap, reliability and cross-team work.

  • Establish a sustainable operating cadence and leadership coverage that prevents either team depending on your constant presence.

  • Agree ownership and escalation paths for shared services and failures, start one material improvement in each team and make progress and risk visible.

One year Outlook

  • Both teams deliver predictably against a portfolio that connects secure build, Scout and Docker Hardened Images outcomes without collapsing their distinct missions.

  • Secure Build has delivered material trusted-build or secure-CI capability and reduced operational risk in its inherited production systems.

  • SCS Services has delivered material customer outcomes, while both teams have sustainable on-call, clearer ownership and senior engineers leading broader work.

Docker considers visa sponsorship on a case-by-case basis based on business needs.

Compensation & Equity

Canada: CA$244,550 – CA$392,150 + equity

United States: $174,900 – $282,700 + equity

______________________________________________________________________

Posting Information

  • Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

  • AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

  • Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

  • Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

  • Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

  • Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

  • Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

  • Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

  • Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.

  • Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

  • Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.

  • Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.
